10010101.Content:
To: The One Still Lost in Pillow Paradise,

Had a good rest?
I hope that by the time you read this, you'll be fully recharged and ready to go. I've left some brand-new clothes for you by the window-make sure you wear them properly, okay?
(As for your old outfit... it was a total disaster. I took care of it for you. You're welcome!)

Once you're all set, come find me downstairs-among the crowd, the most dazzling girl of them all, shining like starlight... no need to guess, that's me!

Looking forward to seeing you,
Airona

10010102.Content: Even if you're a legendary adventurer, I can't keep covering your tab like this...

10010103.Content: But I've accepted a new commission. Once it's done, I'll have the money to settle everything.

10010104.Content: Just give me a bit more time-I promise I'll pay it back.

10010105.Content: Even so, this is getting hard for me...

10010106.Content: It is the Seabreeze Festival in Asterleeds.

10010108.Content: Just beyond lies the Pioneer Bureau.

10010110.Content: Asterleeds, the melting pot of cultures, welcomes all-

10010112.Content: Let's head to Pioneer Bureau. Maybe they hold the answers we seek.

10010113.Content: Some troublesome little bird's causing chaos at the Seabreeze Festival! <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>, be a dear and visit Arena Town to help out that glum purple-haired fellow.

10010114.Content: (First of all... Shall we check the Anchor Notes?)

10010200.Content: <style="emph-gn">(Another Teleportal... Since we're here, might as well activate it.)</style>

10010202.Content: Obviously-we first obtain the <style="emph-gn">adventurer's mandatory credentials</style>. The Pioneer Bureau isn't some back-alley club, you know!

10010203.Content: Prepare in advance any materials that can prove your abilities-it will make the official registration process much smoother!

10010204.Content: Airona, you seem pretty familiar with the Pioneer Bureau, don't you?

10010206.Content: That was quite a flight. You've truly mastered the strength of the Talents.

10010207.Content: Next, we return to Asterleeds to investigate the source of the Void Engram.

10010208.Content: Feels pretty damn good to ride the wind, doesn't it?

10010209.Content: Sure does... Alright, prepare for landing.

10010210.Content: Something is off about this place...

10010211.Content: Here it is... Just as I feared-the demi-humans in this place have all been eroded by Void Corruption.

10010213.Content: Something's off about this place... Stay sharp.

10010215.Content: There's something unusual up ahead. Let's go investigate.

10010216.Content: Follow this road and you'll soon arrive at the Pioneer Bureau.

10010218.Content: Naturally, Asterleeds is celebrating the Seabreeze Festival.

10010220.Content: The Seabreeze Festival marks the city-state's independence.

10010221.Content: Every home displays sea lilies by their doors, symbols of blessings and peace.

10010222.Content: If we're lucky, we might catch sight of Vita and Rab-the festival's mascot cats.

10010223.Content: And let's not forget the romantic legends tied to the festival. I'll tell you all about them later.

10010224.Content: The Pioneer Bureau is just ahead-don't forget to activate the Engram Hub here!

10010227.Content: Come on, we need to see what's happening!

10010229.Content: It seems a fierce battle broke out here.

10010232.Content: There's something unusual up ahead. Let's go investigate.

10010233.Content: Watch your step, everyone. We'll be safe once we reach Asterleeds!

10010234.Content: How's the wound? Honestly... you shouldn't have followed me.

10010235.Content: It's not too bad, but... I don't think I can walk back alone. My legs won't stop shaking.

10010236.Content: Don't worry. I'll take you back myself.

10010238.Content: These black energies... Damn it, everyone, be on your guard!

10010239.Content: (Tina gave me a Loot Opening Voucher. I should be able to use it now.)

10010240.Content: (What a strange dream... But even if it was just a dream, everything felt so vivid... and familiar...)

10010241.Content: (Forget it for now. There's a letter on the cabinet beside the bed. Could it be for me?)

10010242.Content: Olvera should be somewhere in Arena Town to the north. Let's go find her.

10010245.Content: She might be inside the Cliff Ruins. We should keep moving forward.

10010246.Content: The Cliff Ruins is right there inside. The Void Engram... it's thick. Why would it gather here of all places? Stay sharp.

10010247.Content: See that <style="emph-gn">purple-haired fellow</style> over there? He's a staff for the Festival. Let's go talk to him.

To {*me.name*}:

Make good use of this "Asterleeds Chaos Survival Guide!" As the sworn rival of Brave Kitten, you must not act like a reckless rookie!

1. Always keep a box of Healing Aromatic in your backpack: For emergencies, to prevent sudden fainting.
2. To enhance your weapon: Go to the Artisan Guild and find a Legacy expert. There's nothing they can't handle.

Your sworn enemy, the star-blessed Brave Kitten, Narulu.

10010311.Content:
Alician Calendar Year 602: Protective Measures Enacted for Tina

Following the restoration of the Hruga Seal, Tina's unique identity became a matter of continental security across Magna.
Due to potential risks, the majority of council members advocated for protective measures. This decision came with restrictions on Tina's freedom—she would be confined to the Asteria Plains.
Tina ultimately understood and accepted the terms of this protection order. The measure was smoothly implemented under the supervision of Olvera, Defense Corps Commander.

10010312.Content:
Alician Calendar Year 608: Reassessment of Tina's Identity and Power

Amid past unrest, Tina repeatedly defended Asteris, proving her strength and loyalty. Even under scrutiny, she quietly continued to protect the city.
Voices began to rise within the Council—Tina has shown she can safeguard both herself and Asteris. Her power and contributions deserve proper recognition, and she should be posthumously awarded the Hero Medal.
As time passed, this proposal gained the support of the majority of council members.

10010313.Content:
Last night at 22:00, Tina's file, stored in the council hall, was stolen. At 22:10, I dispatched the Corps to find the suspect, while also having Jerrad issue a commission as a backup plan.
Today at 13:30, I learned the commission was accepted. Not long after, at 13:50, Tina brought in Abeku. He confessed that he had already met with the buyer but still had a few remaining pages of the file.
To find the remaining pages, I went to the Pioneer Bureau to inquire with the guide. I only obtained the clue "a powerful green-haired beautiful girl and a clear-eyed adventurer duo."
Combining this with Jerrad's recent eyewitness testimony at the Festival, I believe the ones who accepted the commission were Lady Airona and her new companion.
To find the remaining file pages as soon as possible, I contacted all Seabreeze Festival stall owners to help find them. I know Lady Airona dislikes trouble, and my making such a big fuss will surely annoy her.
... But for the safety of Asterleeds and Tina, please forgive me, mentor.
However, five minutes later, Tina returned to the Corps. She had already brought back the file! Only after communicating with her did I understand the status of the incident on your end.
I am very sorry. It was my impatience that offended the beloved Lady Airona and the respected {*me.name*}.
If there is any compensation I can offer, please do not hesitate to ask...

1004301.Content: Ee-chan wants to be a director, so... here goes!

1004302.Content: Everyone, you're all my loveliest actors!

1004303.Content: Come find me when you're ready. Be sure to follow my script closely!

1004304.Content: On a sun-drenched afternoon, the clever Dorothy conceived a spark of inspiration.

1004305.Content: "Hey everyone-just thinking about the Seabreeze Festival in Asterleeds has me fired up! I've been mulling over it day and night... maybe it's time our Guild throws a party of its own. "

1004306.Content: "Thanks so much for all your support so far. Now we've got some work to do to pull this off-

1004307.Content: and I'll need everyone's help to make it happen!" Seeing the eager expressions on his companions' faces, Dorothy declared with joyful determination.

1004308.Content: Dress up as an <style="emph-gn">artisan</style> and take a seat <style="emph-gn">near Dorothy</style>.

1004309.Content: The artisans journeyed across rugged mountains and winding valleys to reach the Misty Cloud Mountain, where clouds drifted like a dream-tangible yet elusive.

1004310.Content: Some clouds held firm beneath their feet, while others vanished at a touch. As the group gazed at the White Cloud Dewdrop ahead, uncertainty shadowed their faces.

1004311.Content: Alright, time to see if these clouds hold up or disappear beneath me! Don't worry about me. I've got a bunch of leaves ready to cushion the plunge. "

1004312.Content: "Then I'm coming too!" "Count me in!" With those words, the tension lifted, and their thrilling descent into the white clouds began.

1004313.Content: <style="emph-gn">Harvest the White Cloud Dewdrop on the other side!</style>

1004314.Content: The Eastern Sea churned with fury, tornadoes twisted like voracious beasts, ready to consume everything in their wake.

1004315.Content: As Skyfish swarmed the skies like a tempest, the artisans calmly raised their woven baskets, prepared for this very moment.

1004316.Content: Undeterred by the danger, they pressed forward into the heart of the tempest.

1004317.Content: To their dismay, a savage wind suddenly whipped across the shore...

1004318.Content: Use the baskets<style="emph-gn"> to snatch fishes as they fell</style>.

1004319.Content: Every stone in the Thousand-Rock Dunes weighed as much as a fallen mountain.

1004320.Content: Even when working together, the artisans strong as oxen could only move them little by little.

1004321.Content: Yet now, they were all swept up in a shared conviction, their original purpose, a simple evening banquet, long forgotten.

1004322.Content: "Quick, push them this way!" Dorothy waved and called out from afar.

1004324.Content: The artisans gathered all the materials, and Dorothy finalized the preparations.

1004325.Content: The preparation lasted three days and nights. At last, the joy of success painted across every face.

1004326.Content: Under the spotlight, everyone danced with passion.

1004327.Content: Beside them, the bonfire blazed-like the hearts of the artisans, always burning.

1004329.Content: Cut! Thank you for your hard work-preparations for the next scene are underway.

1004330.Content: Such heartfelt, touching stories from the artisans... I was moved to tears.

1004332.Content: Hee hee. This stage play ends perfectly. Thank you all for your cooperation.

1004333.Content: "First things first, we've gotta brew the White Dew Wine. The key ingredient is <style="emph-gn">White Cloud Dewdrop</style>, and you can only find them in the heart of Misty Cloud Mountain of Asterleeds. "

1004334.Content: "Next up, the tornadoes've been tossing swarms of Skyfish onto the shore lately in Eastern Sea. And rumor has it, if you manage to <style="emph-gn">catch one mid-air</style> and eat it, you're set with good luck!"

1004335.Content: "Third on the list, the Thousand-Rock Dunes are packed with all kinds of rocks. <style="emph-gn">Bring some back</style>, and I'll turn them into glowing orbs. "

1004336.Content: "Once everything's wrapped up, I'll go all out to prepare a feast you'll never forget, thanks again, everyone! " Dorothy gave a slight bow as he closed the meeting. Thus, the artisans' passion was set ablaze.

1004337.Content: If you're all ready, come to me for makeup!

10050501.Content:
Tales of Girls—The New Chaos Novel Tops the Charts Again!
The mysterious Chaos light-novelist "Sleepless Mist" strikes again with another bestseller! The story follows five girls caught in the twisted love and hate of youth. It's so intense that readers can't put it down.

Editor's Note: The more twisted the love, the more addictive it becomes.

Stone or Treasure? Alchemy's Reputation at Risk!
Alchemy mentor Maurice discovered a new kind of stone on the plains, claiming that it could change everything people know about the subconscious.

Editor's Note: Why such a fuss? It's just a rock.

Highland Legacy Unearthed! Artisan Guild on the Move!

The moment word broke out about Legacy discovered in the Bahamar Highlands, the Artisan Guild dispatched experts to investigate. People in the Entertainment District are betting whether it's a priceless artifact or just some rusted scrap.

Editor's Note: No one knows the truth yet, but this buzz alone could fuel a year's worth of hype.

Adventurers Collapse—Plains Border in Turmoil Again!
Rumors swirl across the city that several adventurers fainted at the border between the Plains and Highlands. Some insist it's a new kind of contagious disease. Others swear it's just some adventurers trying to escape work.

Editor's Note: With the Pioneer Bureau's rewards so stingy lately, a strike might be fair enough...

10090101.Content: Is this Lallipar? It feels a bit deserted.

10090103.Content: (The villagers who used to gather beneath the old tree to chat have vanished...)

10090104.Content: (The children who filled the streets with laughter are nowhere to be seen.)

10090105.Content: (Where have the diligent folk of Lallipar gone?)

10090106.Content: (Are the Caprahorns this restless because their owner isn't around?)

10090108.Content: (Outside the warehouse, crates are stacked-two colors, but both brimming with Starsoul Flasks.)

10090110.Content: Adventurer, thank you for always looking after us.

10090111.Content: These days, whenever I feel tired, I think of you.

10090112.Content: I want to be brave and resolute like you, someone who can help everyone.

10090115.Content: (No one answers the knock at Fafaala's door. It seems Fafaala isn't home.)

10090201.Content:
Walking east across the highland... I freeze dead at the edge of that sheer precipice. The ground is littered with purple Crystal Clusters, casting an eerie glow. And in the center... a colossal Illusory Bloom stands! Its petals, stained deep like blood, are so sinister they chill me to the bone. Vines drape down, hiding a pitch-black opening within the shadow of its roots.
I dare not approach, but I feel it—whatever dwells within is pure malevolence.
O Bapharian Divine... if you truly hear us, please guide our way.

10090301.Content: (Takes a deep breath)... These Illusory Blooms must be purged as well...

10090302.Content: The danger here should be resolved...

1010001.Content: Look for special creatures at the gates of Asteria and in various monster gathering areas!

10100101.Content: ...How strange. It's broad daylight, so why does it feel like everyone is sleepwalking?

10100102.Content: Fafala, <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style> and I are back! Are you in there?

10100105.Content: I remember, it was a week ago...

10100106.Content: That day, many people from the Bapharian Creed came...

10100107.Content: Even Lord Boyce. It didn't feel right...

10100108.Content: I don't get it. They brought so many Starsoul Flasks this time... Could something serious be happening?

10100109.Content: Be careful, something ahead feels off...

10100110.Content: (Am I really... still not strong enough...? Do I always have to rely on the strength of others...?)

10100111.Content: (No, now isn't the time to get distracted! Lord Boyce is still fighting hard, and I can't give up either...!)

10100112.Content: (It's Grandpa Alphonse... Why is he still out this late?)

10100113.Content: Go back and rest, child. Tomorrow... I'm afraid it will be another long day.

10100114.Content: As the night deepened, I walked along the familiar path toward home. But just as I was about to reach the door... melodious flute music drifted over on the night wind.

10100116.Content:
Adventurer, Airona,
I'm sorry for writing to you so suddenly, and for my messy handwriting. I don't really know how to put this...
Some things have happened here in Lallipar recently. I've been thinking about them by myself for a long time... but I feel like I need to talk them through with you.
If you see this letter, could you please return to Lallipar as soon as possible?
I'll be waiting for you at home.

Fafala

10100301.Content: Airona, <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>... The sound of the flute that's been playing... it seems to have completely disappeared!

10100302.Content: Also... Is there someone... ahead of us?

10100303.Content: Oh, it's Miss Darya. Brought new friends today? Please, have a seat. What would everyone like to eat?

10100304.Content: Help—someone help me! Is the fierce wind of fate about to tear me apart right here?

10100305.Content: Listen! Someone is calling for help!

10100307.ChatName: -The Healing Table of the Valley and the Hearth-
10100307.Content:
Appetizer: "Limestone Hot Spring Platter"
Soft-boiled eggs slow-cooked in stalactite spring water
Thick-cut dried meat patties marinated in rock salt
A rustic gift from Montegnor Valley. The authentic roughness and warmth soothe every weary traveler.

Main Dish: "Steaming Ore-Fire Stew"
Thick chunks of beast meat, alpine cabbage, and plump wild mushrooms bubbling in a clay pot provide just the right amount of heat to dispel the chill of the valley's cold night winds. Highly recommended!

Drink: "Waterfall Warm Stone Tea"
Waterfall ferns slow-steeped in mineral water flowing from rock crevices. The first sip carries a slightly bitter roughness, followed by a pure sweetness from deep within the rock formations. Highly recommended!

Dessert: "Bor Bean Paste and Fated Jam Scones"
Ripe, fallen red Bor beans are collected, mashed, and baked, then generously spread with sweet and sour wild jam. Not exactly delicate, but with a grounded flavor that makes one miss home.

10100401.Content: This guy doesn't look too bright. Should we really be following him...?

10100402.Content: (At some point, a thick fog rolled in, completely swallowing the path ahead...)

10100403.Content: ...What? The way back has been completely covered by the mist!

10100404.Content: Everyone! Behold, those who drove away the calamity that beset me on this long, misty night!

10100405.Content: Fate's generosity has brought us the most honorable guests. Wake up! Our camp is truly graced by their presence today!

10120302.Content: Hmph, the lazy kitty won't even play with us...

10120303.Content: This Rab is too apathetic! We should report it to the Pioneer Bureau!

10120402.Content: Want to become a bonafide adventurer? Sign up now!

10120404.Content: It's a holiday today-why are these poor kitties still working?!

10120405.Content: Hey there! A friend I haven't met yet!

10120501.Content: (I wonder how Airona's investigation is going...)

10120601.Content: By the hair of Lamond... someone help, anyone!

10130101.Content: Will these things harm anyone passing by?

10130102.Content: I doubt it. They're just leftover traces. The real threat is the Void Engram itself.

10130103.Content: We need to find it quickly...

10130201.Content: If we keep moving forward, we'll reach the meeting hall, right? I think there's an event scheduled there today...

10130204.Content: We must inform the Asterleeds Defense Corps immediately.

10130205.Content: I only hope we're not too late...

10130301.Content: The trail of Void Engram ends here, but it must still be close.

10130302.Content: Jerrad was nearby as well-we decided to ask for his help.

10130303.Content: (The traces of Void Engram... they all point in the same direction...)

10130304.Content: If Void Engram has seeped into the city, it must have left signs. Keep your eyes open-move ahead and investigate.

10130306.Content: But why would he hide all this? What is he waiting for...? Let's check the area over there.

10130307.Content: Come on, the ceremony is just ahead!

10130309.Content: These black energies... Damn it, everyone, be on your guard!

10130401.Content: Lady Airona! And is that... a new recruit with you?

10130601.Content: All of the finest forging masters in Asterleeds-and perhaps the entire continent-belong to the Artisan Guild!

10130602.Content: Just to be safe, I'd like the artisan to prepare a weapon suited to you before we meet the Commander.

10130603.Content: You helped me today-consider the cost covered.

10130605.Content: Hey, don't be so formal with me!

10140101.Content: Tina once served as my adjutant. On the battlefield, we moved like twin blades.

10140102.Content: She was my second set of hands and eyes. I could trust her in any situation.

10140103.Content: Though... that doesn't seem to be the case anymore.

10140104.Content: Something changed between us. Perhaps you'll come to understand it, in time.

10140105.Content: Your turn to speak, adventurer. The Void Engram has crept into both the plains and the city-what's your take?

10140106.Content: Maybe it's the work of the same forces behind the spy we uncovered.

10140107.Content: If only it were that simple...

10140201.Content: I think I heard Lady Airona, <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>.

10140301.Content: (Wait... something's appeared where Tina stood before...?)

10140302.Content: (No-stay focused. We'll investigate later. I only hope Tina's safe...)

10140303.Content: (The Void Engram and the Medal... It's time to investigate their connection.)

10510209.Content:
To the Friends of Narulu,

By the time you read this, my husband and I will have already evacuated with the Asterleeds Defense Corps. Please, do not worry for our safety.

We know all too well the plains are suffering a disaster unlike anyone has seen before. This is all the doing of the Dark Mist Legion and their leader, Denvel. They are the ones who brought about Narulu's tragic fate.

The path you walk is filled with danger. You must not be burdened by the sorrows of the past. Let this sorrow be ours to bear.

Please, take care of yourselves, and be ever vigilant.
May the seabreeze answer your will and bless your journey.

Agnes

10540201.Content:
1. Long ago, during the era when the Divine governed Regnus, the planet's Engram was abundant. Where this strength converged, Stellariums formed, and from their power crystallized the Core of Stellarium.
2. The arrogant Igdias once sought to monopolize the Stellariums, only to be driven out by the Divine-yet not before stealing several Core of Stellarium.
3. Hruga's strength stems from the Core of Stellarium, a force that has become inseparable from her very being. Yet, such a fusion is not without consequence-
for when the Core of Stellarium binds itself to a mortal, it inevitably bends to the wielder's spiritual strength. In time, Hruga drew upon the power of the Void Engram, an act that tainted and eroded both her own heart and the Core of Stellarium itself.

10540301.Content: (Jerrad, Valeria, Dorothy... They're at The Double-Faced Coin too!)

10540302.Content: (It's getting late. I should head upstairs and rest.)

10540303.Content:
You looked so peaceful sleeping yesterday, I couldn't bring myself to pull back your blanket...
You've been working so hard. Take all the rest you need.

Once you've had your fill of sleep, come find me downstairs.

There's something important I need to tell you.
Airona

10610102.Content: The monsters are getting more and more aggressive... Adventurer, my house is nearby. If you trust me, I can take care of the unconscious lady for now...

10610201.Content: Is this your first visit to the Bahamar Highlands, right?

10610202.Content: The <style="emph-gn">Illusory Plague</style> strikes frequently here. You must be fully prepared before venturing forth.

10610203.Content: Should you encounter any difficulty, do not hesitate to ask.

10610204.Content: We do not ignore anyone's suffering.

10610301.Content: First, we check on Airona's condition...

10620101.Content: Just as expected-they turned us away. But from the guard's words, it sounds like caravans are still being let through.

10620102.Content: The easiest way to reach the mines is via the village.

10620103.Content: This place is meant as a temporary resting spot for pilgrims. But everyone stays longer, and thus Lallipar is born.

10620104.Content: Stone houses, cotton, and wheat fields... It is simple, but that is a rare sight on this highland.

10620105.Content: See over there? That enormous thing is the Pillar of Divinity.

10620106.Content: The Bapharian Creed​ reveres this place as a Holy Land. Guards and Priests are stationed here year-round.

10620107.Content: Pilgrims often pitch their tents nearby. It gets quite lively.

10620108.Content: We are almost there. The mine Checkpoint is just ahead.

10620109.Content: The Sislesa Mine is Byrnhald's gold mine. Miners and Squad soldiers swarm the place, busy as bees.

10620110.Content: Alas... I just hope the guards at the Checkpoint don't give us trouble...

10620201.Content: Then we've no other choice... Let's move!

10620301.Content: Ow... my stomach. I can't take another step...

10630101.Content: Hehe, a path this thrilling is worthy of the title of adventurer.

10630102.Content: You've got a good eye finding this hidden road.

10630103.Content: Jump, jump! If you can land in one piece, I'll admit you have what it takes to be a treasure hunter!

10630104.Content: Oh dear... too many uninvited guests.

10630201.Content: (Holding the ore in one's hand, I can immediately sense the immense Engram within-its purity and scale far surpassing human imagination.)

10630202.Content: (The Sislesa Mine is under the strict control of the Blackstone Legion—better steer clear of their patrols.)

10630203.Content: The light inside the bottle has gone out... Did it work?

10630204.Content: (He remains weak and feeble, but his complexion has visibly improved.)

10630206.Content: Cough-hack! I... I'm not being taken away...?

10630301.Content: What... is this place?! These monsters look so strange...

10630302.Content: It seems we've been pulled into an Illusion. Let's deal with the monsters first!

10810101.Content: Even disguised as traveling merchants, we're walking a fine line. If we're caught red-handed, it'll mean real trouble.

10810104.Content: We shouldn't linger here. We need to move-fast.

10810105.Content: Heh! You're telling me! Let's move our asses already!

10810106.Content:
Milo should be nearby.
Grieg said he's wearing a red hat-shouldn't be hard to spot.

10810201.Content: Wait-Mr. Breck left something. Hold on, I'll return it.

10810202.Content: No... I think he meant for us to have this.

10810203.Content:
Wow, a locked door.
{*me.name*}, where's that key? Let's take it out and try!

10810204.Content: (The key fit perfectly. A soft click echoed-locked from within.)

10810205.Content:
Sorry about this, but we need to defend ourselves.
Hope you can understand.

10810206.Content: (This looks like the path to get down there.)

10810207.Content: (It seems a blade stands driven into the ground.)

10810209.Content: (Hope there are still some unlooted First Aid Kits left.)

10810210.Content: (Hmm? These meds are near expiration, but they've kept well... Should be usable.)

10810211.Content: (Let's see if there's any food around here.)

10810212.Content: (Lucky. These cans are still intact. The water's a bit dusty, but at least it's not contaminated.)

10810213.Content: (I've got everything I need. Time to head back to the Safe House.)

10810301.Content: The bandages are stained red. The person must be seriously injured. This is not good news...

10810302.Content:
The footprints are sparse and chaotic.
Devin's group was small, and they left in a hurry.

10810304.Content: These monsters are becoming more aggressive. I hope Devin and his team are still holding out.

10810305.Content: Devin didn't give up when he was cornered, and neither should we.

10810307.Content:
Just because he became a First Priest in the highlands, Lothar puts on such airs! Saying he's "busy with matters" and just brushing us aside. If it weren't for official business, you think I'd be willing to deal with the Creed?! At least we can return to our country after inspecting the mine.

...

The Crimson Marrow yield plummeted by at least 30% compared to last year. The Drava Royal Institute is barely operational. The duke is furious. Shouldn't Klaus give a proper explanation?! Yet instead of showing up himself, he sent his aide, Reiner, to brush us off! We must report this neglect to the duke when we return...

(The paper, pristine in its craftsmanship—white, supple, untouched by the passage of time. Yet, the notebook bore the scars of neglect, its pages marred by ochre stains, fused together in stubborn resistance. Sticky to the touch, they refused to yield.)

10820101.Content: (The smelting facility's doors are tightly shut.)

10820102.Content: Here are the finished products, ready to be loaded for transport.

10820103.Content: Mmm... There's clearly no Crimson Marrow in these boxes.

10820104.Content:
This area's still part of the smeltery... and they say slag is buried here.
But are we sure it's only slag?

10820105.Content: Looks like this area is restricted.

10820201.Content: The ore crates on the vehicle are stacked neatly-fully inspection-proof, free of any contraband substances.

10820202.Content: Maybe we could look for surveillance blind spots?

10820203.Content: I sense Hruga's presence! Can we manage to get closer?

10820204.Content: Is everything operating normally with the smelting equipment?

10820205.Content: This is a... serious matter. We won't take it lightly. You have our word.

10830101.Content:
Darya had left a mark behind.
A carved arrow pointed deeper into the mining zone.

10830102.Content:
So many checkpoints... Alerting them will cause trouble for the miners.
{*me.name*}, we need to move quietly.

10830103.Content: Are the miners okay, I wonder...

10830104.Content: The eavesdropper's motives are unclear. We need to smoke them out.

10830201.Content: Is Boyce worried we'll mess this up?

10830202.Content: Whatever happens, I have to fulfill the mission Master Lothar entrusted to me. Every change in the mine must be reported.

10830205.Content: What on earth is going on... Let's go find out.

10830206.Content: We'll need to create a distraction. Get the sentry's attention.

10830208.Content: When you head out, always carry a change of clothes.

10830209.Content: During travels, when unexpected situations arise, whipping out an emergency kit is always the right move!

10830210.Content: This jar contains the wind from that stormy night in Asterleeds. It must've meant something special to Tina.

10830211.Content: True to its name, the jar encapsulates Asterleeds' gentle seabreeze, its rhythm whispering through the air like a quiet pulse of the city.

10830212.Content: The wind, gathered during Seabreeze Festival, carried with it the echoes of countless voices, especially when taking a deep breath.

1101001.Content:
Captain Jayden believes that the passage to leave here is behind the door, hopefully so. To be honest, I don't know if it's his intuition as a reconnaissance captain or if he's just trying to comfort our despair.
However, the key to open the door is on those terrifying giant machines, defeating them is impossible. Captain Jayden plans to send a small team to lure them to the door, and once the door opens automatically, lure them away so the rest can escape...
But this also means that the team responsible for luring the machines will never be able to leave.
I don't know why I still raised my hand voluntarily, is it because I am the oldest team member? Or have I already given up? Damn it, I can't help but feel scared at a time like this...

11106001.Content:
[Year X, Month X, Light Fog]
Mother gave birth to a girl. She possesses the same golden eyes as I do—the mark of a Singer.
As the successor to the Singer, I have followed the previous Singer since birth, learning those obscure notes, rarely able to stay by my parents' side.
I know it was loneliness that drove them to have another child.
...Unfortunately for them, she also had golden eyes.
Fagaro's laws are ironclad​—there can only be one successor. That's why they ruthlessly stripped her of her right to be a part of the troupe.
The situation became a secret I was forced to carry. Watching the carriage take her away, I felt as if I had been burdened with an unforgivable sin.
It was because of my absence that she was brought into this world—and it was because of my existence that she was denied even a single night of peaceful sleep in her parents' arms.
Mother told me that they named her Fafala, for a tiny, yet incredibly resilient flower that grows in the crevices of rocks.
I picked a fafala flower today and pinned it in my hair.
If she is destined to leave, then let me carry her name and wander this earth forever in her stead.

11106002.Content:
[Year X, Month X, Heavy Snow]
The wave of monsters took everything. My parents, our kin, and the previous Singer. Overnight, our troupe was reduced to just a handful of people.
I was forced to take ownership of that jar filled with liquid memories. When the truth of the past flooded my mind, I was nearly crushed by despair.
Descendants of Igdias... the bloodline of the witch...
It turns out we were never travelers seeking beautiful music. We are merely cursed sinners.
We must forever wander the wilderness in search of a lost melody, never worthy of a journey home.
It's too absurd... too cruel.
Yet, within this suffocating despair, I actually felt a sliver of relief.
Fafala, my sister... their heartlessness was actually a mercy, freeing you from this quagmire so early in your life.
As long as you're growing up safely somewhere else, I am willing to bear the shackles of fate alone.

11106003.Content:
[Year X, Month X, Sunny Day]
I put on a rough gray cloak, pulled the hood low, and disguised myself as an ordinary traveling merchant before entering Lallipar.
It was the first time I had looked at her so closely.
She had grown taller, her eyes as clear as the highland lakes. I laid out the cheap trinkets I had collected during my travels over the years on a blanket and watched her curiously pick through them.
Finally, she picked up a lake-blue ribbon headband.
That color suited her well.
She helped her neighbors carry water and ran recklessly on the grassy slopes with the village children. The gray-haired old village chief looked at her with unreserved affection.
Compared to me, a distant blood relative, a harbinger of disaster... her family here feels more real.
She has a home that will never bump through the night on a carriage.
When she tied that ribbon and flashed me, a stranger, that unguarded, radiant smile...
I suddenly realized that I was smiling back.
Fafala, my sister.
May the stars forever protect your smile.

11202001.Content:
Boyce, my proudest student.
By the time you read this letter, I will be in the depths of the Augurus Ruins, conducting the most crucial purification ritual.
I have entrusted this masked envoy to deliver the new batch of Starsoul Flasks on my behalf. He is a trusted companion on our path, so treat him with the same respect you show me.
Additionally, you might notice that this batch of Starsoul Flasks exudes a faint mottled crimson luster.
Do not panic. That is the light of penance I extracted while stripping away the curse deep within the ruins. When it first comes into contact with the villagers, it may cause them brief discomfort and confusion. This is the weeds being cleared out from their souls—the necessary labor pains leading to absolute tranquility.
No matter what abnormalities occur in the village, you must ensure that everyone keeps these Starsoul Flasks close to them at all times.
These are my teachings, for the sake of Lallipar Village's ultimate salvation.
"Only when the old branches are burned into red embers can the new sprouts truly see the sun."

Lothar

I was sent again today to reinforce the east-side Anti-Gravity Ring. Denvel calls these devices the "dawn of a new era," but every time I get near them, I feel uneasy.
... With our current status, are we really still qualified to use these Divine Legacies? What are Legacies made of, anyway? Are they sacred or defiled? Who can say?

At lunch, old Cole from the mess said three new recruits from the northern barracks went missing last night. The patrol found their dog tags with black mist lingering on them...

16000101.Content:
The whispers of the ancestral spirits ride the wind, bringing word of the turning moon.

Our Kanamia Brave, how have you been?

Since your departure, our people have rebuilt homes torn down by the hurricane. The Forbidden Land has reopened, thanks to the key you recovered...

But whenever the moon's reflection appears whole upon the Spirit River, the children always ask me and my father: "When will the Kanamia Brave who dispersed the hurricane return? "

I don't know how to answer their questions. I can only stare at the moon during my short breaks from work, hoping to glimpse your distant figure.

As I write this, the tribe is preparing for the Harvest Festival. The attendants are coating the wooden pillars with sacred oil, and the altar is taking shape.
It is not just a grand ceremony of gratitude to the ancestral spirits. It is the moment for our people to finally smile again after hardship.

And you, the hero who saved our tribe, the Kanamia Brave... Will you not come share the tribe's new brew, taste the Kanamia Harvest Feast? Or perhaps... challenge me to see who can mold the Ash Pact into a stranger shape?

Priestess Rolora of Kanamia
At moonrise

(At the bottom of the letter, a line of words is repeatedly scrawled.)

You'll come, right?

17021001.Content:
To the Adventurer still struggling in dull reality:

You must be tired of the same old routines—and that endless rainy weather.
I know I was. So I turned my dreams into reality and created a place where joy never fades.
People say dreams are fleeting bubbles. In my view, that is only because they lack the power to keep those bubbles close.
Because of my peculiar constitution, I wander through different worlds in my dreams each night. The scenery is so breathtaking that it would be a shame if I alone could behold it.
If I can see it, then so can everyone else. So I borrowed a touch of the Merchant Guild's influence, reclaimed an island from the sea, and brought every blade of grass from my dreams into the real world.
That is Starland, a miracle floating in the seas of Asterleeds.

Go to Starland, Adventurer.
You need pay nothing. Simply bring those eyes long accustomed to ordinary sights, and witness the world within my mind.
A stage leading to the stars awaits you, along with challenges of modest difficulty. There, destiny may be decided at a wondrous card table—or beneath cherry blossoms, you may drift into a gentle dream.
Everything will unfold as you wish.
Enjoy yourself.

Meowlux Merchant Guild
Meowclu

17021101.ChatName: To the Members of the Artisan Guild
17021101.Content:
I am Totoka of the Advanced Investigation Squad.
If this letter safely reaches the Guild, it means I have no other choice but to request outside assistance.
We were ordered to investigate the ancient mech that appeared above the highlands. At first, everything seemed normal. Although its scale was astonishing, it appeared to be nothing more than scrap remnants of a bygone era, with only parts of its outer shell and structure still recognizable.
Master Graylen concluded that it should have completely shut down long ago; Master Karst, however, became unusually excited upon seeing it, insisting it was a rare and invaluable relic.
But the further we continued our investigation, the more something felt wrong.
That mech is not merely simple wreckage. In the gaps of its armor, deep within its joints, and even around its core, we could clearly see traces of erosion caused by Illusory Blooms!
Now, the two masters have personally ventured deep inside for quite some time.
I was originally stationed outside as support, but I have waited a long time and neither has returned.
...It is my own cowardice. I dare not go in without authorization.
With my abilities, I would likely just be a hindrance if I went inside. But if I keep waiting like this, I truly fear something may happen to the masters.
Thus, I can only write this letter and request the Guild to send reinforcements as soon as possible.
If possible, please be sure to enlist adventurers capable of handling dangerous situations.

—Advanced Investigation Squad, Artisan Guild
Totoka

17100101.Content:
From her very first day at the Guild, Emeria's brilliance shone through.
Confronted with the underpowered first-generation Engram Engine, she dared to propose radical improvements-
many of which were eventually adopted by the Chief Artisan, ushering in the creation of the second-generation Engram Engine.
Engram Engine would go on to power not only wooden fishing boats but small ships, thanks to her contributions.
More crucially, it achieved mass production of Engram Engine, enabling its widespread application in maritime domains.

Yet Emeria's vision reached further still.
Though the Bapharian Legacy far surpasses current technology, she believes it hindered sustainable growth.
Humanity, she warned, had built upon foundations it did not comprehend.

To forge a new path, she invented the "Astral Differentiator," a steam-and-gear-driven computational device.
At the time, the differentiator was widely employed for calculating complex parameters-utilizing no Bapharian Legacy whatsoever.
This invention earned her the prestigious Ocean Platinum Card, personally awarded by the Council Chair.

Yet, her life was cut short at the pinnacle of triumph.
Tragically, Emeria perished in an experiment at merely 42 years of age.

17100102.Content: It's empty... Let's split up and search for the differentiator.

17100103.Content: Adventurer! Over here-this might be it: "Instructions for Operating the Astral Differentiator!"

17100104.Content:
1. Preheat the machine
- Open the coal storage compartment and ignite the coal.
- Monitor the temperature gauge and wait until it reaches 100.

2. Switch to calculation mode
- Insert the punched card into the upper-right probe socket, then quickly retreat from the machine.
- Await the completion of computational gearset switching.

*Never touch the machine while the traction cable is in motion!

3. Input calculation parameters
- Rotate the input wheel to the designated position.
- Do not lean against the gear assemblies.

4. Begin calculation
- Activate the steam valve located at the machine's top-left.
- Stand by for computation completion.

5. Output Results
- Calculation may take anywhere from seconds to several minutes.
- Wait quietly for the T-hammer to print the computed results.

17100107.Content:
When you read this note, I bring you glad tidings:
This island now belongs to you. Make haste-travel to Ocean Hill and register its coordinates without delay.

And since you've stepped onto this Misty Island, my mission may yet endure.
The box with the needle attached is my flight data box-used to record all aerial parameters.
It marks the last beacon left by my shattered ornithopter and proves that it crossed the unknown skies and arrived on the far side.

I beg you-carry it to the Asterleeds Artisan Guild.
It alone bears witness that someone as ordinary as I once pierced what seemed an insurmountable barrier.
It alone holds the key for humanity to defy the so-called curse of the skies and soar freely once more.

17100108.Content:
Seven years ago, during a high-stress trial of the Engram Engine II, the system failed-and in that moment, I brushed against the very edge of technological possibility.
The coordinates were clearly within reach, yet an invisible force barred all passage. That island...
it stands as both the furthest boundary our ships can reach and the line I have never been able to cross.

And yet, the more impossible the barrier seemed, the deeper my desire grew to overcome it.
It was then that I turned my gaze skyward-toward a path long forsaken by others, and thus devoted myself to aircraft research and development.
The first ornithopter soon took shape. Though countless simulations confirmed the data's accuracy, each test flight ended in failure.
Undeterred, I delved into ancient manuscripts, forgotten blueprints, and the scattered remnants of past endeavors. Each account, without exception, pointed to a chilling truth:
whenever the aircraft approached a certain altitude, it vanished-erased with surgical precision by an unknown force.

Something-beyond the grasp of our current technology-seemed to guard the skies, enforcing a boundary none had crossed.

But I have never been one to yield to the unknown. And so, I chose to ascend myself.
Only by confronting it directly could I hope to uncover the truth-whether beyond that mist lies nature's forbidden zone-or the domain of some unseen will.
Though the path forward is veiled in fog, and the journey may well lead to peril, I find myself without the option to turn back.

17100109.Content:
Even before I departed, I understood the cost-this flight was a gamble with life itself.
In the old fables, a father and son dared to chase the sun with wings of wax. Their ambition ended in tragedy, their wings melted by the heat, their bodies claimed by the sea.
-Now, standing on the edge of the unknown, I find myself not so different from them.

But my friend, do not mourn me.

In the final moment, as the ornithopter was torn apart mid-air, I experienced a clarity unlike any I've ever known!

I glimpsed the truth-that shroud of mist is no natural phenomenon, but a barrier imbued with will!
Though my ornithopter collapsed under the immense force, its destruction was not in vain. That moment of failure yielded our most precious discovery:
The so-called "insurmountable" boundary proved otherwise-it left behind measurable data, evidence that its limits are not beyond reach.

17100110.Content: I found it! Adventurer- over here, quickly!

17100111.Content:
This data box holds the final fragments of my journey-the knowledge I wrested from "it" at the very cost of my life.
In those last seconds, the data box captured invaluable evidence:
Surges of eerie heatwaves, hyper-directional pressure, and energy pulses powerful enough to cripple any device...

Please, take this data box back with you-every bit of truth we've uncovered is locked inside.
Take it to the Artisan Guild-and tell them this: Emeria, the one who dared to defy the unknown, didn't fail.
Her body may have been broken, but before the end, she hurled a spear at the invisible wall.
Yes-human creation can pierce the forbidden sky.

The complete designs for ornithopters are recorded in those notebooks labeled "ASH," locked away in the Guild's basement vault.
With the parameters contained in this data box, the design can be perfected. The curse that binds us to the earth can be broken!

Though my flesh may rot here, this data box will become the wind beneath the wings of all who dare to follow.
Let the will of humankind rewrite the rules of this world!

20002106.Content:
Log Entry #01
Perhaps we underestimated the Cabbage Mission.
It is true they recruit idle young folks from the nearby area.
But that's exactly the point, those guys don't understand the Legacies, let alone their true value.
To them, a priceless Legacy is worth less than a bowl of seafood risotto at The Spinning Rudder...
Sending these grunts to retrieve Legacies ensures they won't try to pocket the goods themselves.

Log Entry #07
The Cabbage Mission's brass... they are holding the real deal!
I witnessed it with my own eyes: they used a glowing Legacy to slow time right there.
Furthermore, the rumored "Anti-Gravity" effect has been confirmed... Threat Level must be raised immediately.
Primary Objective: Pinpoint the storage location of all Legacies.

Log Entry #12
That was close! I tailed them too closely yesterday and was spotted by an Officer.
Good thing I'm quick-witted; I had a cover story ready...
Not that I'm afraid of getting caught!
Additional note: These guys are helpless against Illusory Blooms. If I do get cornered,
I'll just jump into one of them! Better to live in my own fantasy than be butchered by this lot.

Log Entry #15
Finally found it. Their base is hidden in the Soundless City!
Cunning devils. They operate up in the highlands, but they established their base down in the ruins of the plains.
I still don't know how those guys get in there. It's deep underground...
Speaking of which, the Creed would never guess that significant Legacies are hidden in the ruins right under their noses.
Alas, I can't help but feel bitter. I worked so hard to locate this Legacy, and now it's going to be confiscated.
If I hand it over to the Creed, they'll just lock it away forever...
Is that truly the best use for such power?

20002601.Content:
Month X Day X

It's been quite some time since I arrived. The recruiter said I would at least have enough to eat here... but I haven't... Even the Luno we're given is barely anything.
It's completely different from what I imagined. I came here to make money...
The work is grueling, and the mine conditions are awful. Worst of all, security is handled by the Blackstone Legion. Everyone knows they're a bunch of Byrnie Scrap​s...
They look down on us, act superior, and sometimes hurl insults at us!
Was coming here really the right choice?

20002602.Content:
Month X Day X

I just found out that the open-pit mines outside are worked by miners from Byrnhald!
They... how could they do this? Giving the easy jobs to their own people? What about us? What are we supposed to do?
Some people couldn't take it anymore and started arguing with them. But others...
They actually started families with the Byrnie Scraps? How could they?!
Is it just to live a bit easier down in the mines? I don't understand...
I'm starting to miss home...

20002603.Content:
Month X Day X

Can I still go home? Can I still return to Asterleeds?
There seems to be unrest in the upper ranks of the Blackstone Legion, but I'm just a miner. That's not something I'd ever be told.
I miss my family... my friends...
I want to go back to Asterleeds. I would rather not stay here anymore.
Besides... Reiner is dead! The Blackstone Legion will never let us off. They haven't retaliated yet—but what about later?
I want to leave. I want to get out of here!
But what about my friends down in the mines? Some have started families here. Some are even with Byrnhalds...
If I leave, will they come with me?

20002604.Content: (So some miners from Asterleeds have already started families with miners from Byrnhald...)

20002605.Content: (In that case, I have to consider whether they're willing to return to Asterleeds...)

20002606.Content:
A mud-stained toy, its colors already faded.
The design resembles that of the Duchy of Byrnhald, and it seems to have been played with for a long time.
The owner must have treasured it—some spots even show signs of repainting.
Why it was abandoned here remains unknown...

20002607.Content: (It seems... quite a few families made up of people from Asterleeds and Byrnhald really do live here...)

20002608.Content:
Father, Mother, I've been away from home for a long time now. I don't know what Asterleeds looks like these days...
When I left with a pack on my back, I swore I'd make something of myself. But reality never matches what we imagine.
I'm down in a highlands mine... chewing on black bread, living in constant fear of the Illusory Plague's corruption... and those Blackstone Legion men...
But... I have new ties here now. I married a woman from Byrnhald. In this sunless pit, we've built a small home of our own...
I don't dare write to you. I don't dare go back to see you either. I know you still remember the war, but...
Ordinary people shouldn't have to carry that burden. My wife... she's truly a good person...
Sometimes I wonder—if one day I can really bring her home with me... would you be willing to accept her?

20025001.Content:
After Taylor, everything changed.
Reiner only grew worse, finding new ways to torment us.
Now we have to look around before even taking a breath.

The miners have clashed with the Black Boots several times.
They're working while injured... morale is at rock bottom.

Reiner doesn't care if we live or die.
We're short on water, short on food... but worst of all, we're out of medicine.
Some of the miners' wounds are worsening fast.
If this keeps up, they won't last more than a few days.

Adventurer, you've already done so much for us.
Right now, we truly have no other way...
Darya is busy with the secret route and can't get away.
You're the only one we can count on.

I know, the reinforcements you arranged are on the way.
But it's a long journey, and the situation is chaotic. They won't arrive anytime soon...
We have to survive—hold on until they get here.

If you can, please bring us some "Cleansing Saffron."
It doesn't need to be much—just enough to help those miners pull through.
—Your Old Miner Friend

20025013.Content: To uncover the truth about the <style="emph-gn">List</style>... the only choice is to follow these boot prints and infiltrate the <style="emph-gn">Tower</style> to continue the investigation.

20025014.Content: (...More than one set of footprints. The set here is messier, with short steps and frequent stops... drag marks streak across the ground.)

20025015.Content: (The other set is very neat, evenly spaced, as if heading straight into the depths... back to the Tower?)

20025020.Content: (Then the other set must have returned to the Tower.)

20025022.Content: (Ah! So this is it? The place where Crimson Marrow is stored is the "Tower"?!)

20025023.Content: (It seems Reiner is here, looking down from above as the Crimson Marrow slowly accumulates.)

20025024.Content: (There's too much Crimson Marrow here. Staying in a place like this will have an effect...)

20025025.Content: ...What does this prove? A crown—can it really make them obey?

20025026.Content: Reiner... so he really is connected to the Man in Black. But this voice...

20025027.Content: To be understood by others... you must give up this bit of humanity that makes you look back.

20025028.Content:
...This is not something to write about in a letter.

I know you'll say I've changed, and I know you want an explanation.
However, explanations only make people look back—and I can't anymore.

No one forced me; this was my choice.

If you still remember who I once was,
keep that person with you.
...Don't let him die with me.

...Stop writing. (The letter is torn violently.)

20110107.Content:
Subject: Joint Investigation into Recent Seabreeze Festival Anomalies
Reference Number: WT-608-VII-■■■
People in Charge: Tina, Valeria

Event A: Plain Ghost Incident
Mysterious mist has appeared on the Asteria Plains. Creatures exposed to the mist show signs of confusion and increased aggression.
It has been confirmed that the mist is the ​Void Engram, an evil force that swept the continent three years ago, wielded by the witch Hruga.
The Man in Black involved in this incident faked his death immediately upon discovery and disappeared. According to witnesses, the Man in Black acted exaggeratedly and is suspected to follow the ​Void Engram.

Event B: Tina File Loss Incident
The night before the Seabreeze Festival, Tina's secret files were stolen. Investigation shows the thief was Abeku from the black market while the buyer remained masked and dressed in black.
According to Abeku's testimony, the buyer's behavior closely matches the suspect in Incident A, suggesting they may be the same person.

Event C: Ceremony Explosion Incident
At the Seabreeze Festival fireworks opening, Tina's Seabreeze Medal was sabotaged, causing the ​Void Engram to explode during the ceremony.


[The following content is TOP SECRET!]


Tina suffered from Void Corruption and was trapped in the Cliff Ruins. She was rescued with the help of the adventurer {*me.name*}.
Other witnesses report that Tina's attacker is the black-clad person involved in Incidents A and B, linking the three cases and revealing a conspiracy targeting Tina.

Investigation Results

The Man in Black can freely use Void Engram and targets Tina. This individual is highly likely a follower of Hruga.
Tina is one of the guardians sealing the witch. The attack on Tina is likely motivated by a desire to break the witch's seal and release Hruga.
All parties must stay alert to the witch's movements and keep tracking the Man in Black.

20120106.Content:
Alician calendar, August ■■■, Year 600, Rainy

Rain drums on the tent like a death knell.

I remember Denvel saying: "A true commander fights for peace. Blind sacrifice is meaningless." He always used to say that, but now we're all lingering on the verge of death.

I saw his armor stained red with my own eyes. Each red stain corresponded to a face that would never smile again. He now spends all day caressing that terrible weapon. More than once, I've stumbled upon him in the trenches, muttering the names of fallen comrades to the empty air. Over time, his obsession actually condensed into a visible crystal, like a teardrop-shaped piece of amber... The Imagine Seed traps him in his memories.

But the enemy won't give us time to dream. During the surprise attack the day before yesterday, Denvel ordered the destruction of the civilian evacuation route. When the light of the explosion reflected on his face, I saw, for the first time, the devil's reflection in the Dominion eyes.

This morning, I secretly slipped the Imagine Seed into his overcoat pocket. It was supposed to be the key to saving his last shred of humanity. But he dropped the water cup as if scalded, the crystal shards glinting faintly on the muddy ground like a small corpse. I dare not guess what was hidden in his final gaze. Was it disgust? Anger? Or... fear?

This seed is about to sprout in my pocket. I must do something, before it's too late...

20410108.Content:
I am sorry... so terribly sorry.

I have committed an unforgivable crime. A coward, a fool, a sinner in the eyes of Asterleeds—this is what I have become.

But for the sake of my wife and children, there was no other choice.

It was the Dark Mist Legion... they coerced me into this. But why? They should have been ■■■ three years ago. Is it truly possible that ■■■ still exist in this world?

This afternoon, I will obey the orders given to me and proceed to Ancient City of Vill. This is the price I must pay.

The fireworks last night were the last beautiful sight I will ever see. I'm sorry, my dear wife, my children—I can't join you to celebrate the Seabreeze Festival this year...

If anyone finds this letter, please deliver my apologies to Lady Tina.

I am so sorry, Lady Tina. My cowardice has brought harm upon you, and I am not worthy of asking for forgiveness...I only wish that the Divine would bless you and keep you safe, and that you may survive the coming storm...

Last words
Ryan

Document content:
Document No.: 58
Dark Mist Legion Investigation Record

January, Year 600, Alician calendar
The war began with Byrnhald's Vanguard landing in the Andra Basin. The Andra Landing Battle lasted nearly two months, and the enemy was almost entirely destroyed. However, after the conflict, it became clear that some remnants of the Dark Mist Legion had survived and retreated deep into the plains with their leader, Denvel.

September, Year 600, Alician calendar
In the midst of the war, the Deputy Squad Leader of the Dark Mist Legion, Jayden, along with his reconnaissance team, infiltrated our ranks. Though the reconnaissance operation was thwarted, they were not apprehended. The Asterleeds Defense Corps later received reliable intel confirming that Jayden's team had entered the Towering Ruin during their retreat. None of them survived, and what they encountered in those ruins remains a mystery.

September, Year 601, Alician calendar
A Peace Treaty was signed, and Byrnhald recalled all its squads. But soon after, we were attacked by unknown forces.
It was later confirmed to be the Dark Mist Legion of Byrnhald.Their leader Denvel had refused the recall order.

30002902.Content: (A strangely shaped stone. Its surface is covered in tiny bubbles, and its edges are soft like wax, as if it had melted and then solidified.)

30002903.Content: (A small pinch of grayish-white powder... This is clearly man-made, and the smell is incredibly familiar. What could it be?)

30002904.Content: (This is... a cufflink belonging to one of Sabine's subordinates! One side has strange scorch marks, but the other is completely intact.)

30003001.Content: ...Hey there, Adventurer, mind stepping over here for a word?

30003101.Content: Adventurer, please deal with the monsters nearby.

30003102.Content: Adventurer... Same as always. Those monsters nearby are too noisy. Somebody needs to shut them up.

30003103.Content: Waaah—run!!! It's a monster! It's a monster!

30003301.Content: This should be enough, right? Let's just take it back for now.

30003501.Content: Was that... footage recorded by the Void Watcher?

30003502.Content: Let's check the area. There might be some clues left behind.

30003503.Content: Nothing happened. It seems the Void Watcher is quite special...

30003505.Content: A device destroyed by immense energy. Its original purpose can no longer be determined from its exterior.

30003601.Content: Sid should still have some sea lilies. Go find him.

30003602.Content: So he ended up giving me the hat... Guess he really couldn't sell it, huh?

30003701.Content: It's my first time going this deep. Unusual Engram fluctuations are often detected here.

30003702.Content: I was planning to come here once before leaving the Bahamar Highlands... Didn't expect to make the trip this early.

30003703.Content: It looks exactly like an Engram Monitor... By the grace of the Bapharian Divines.

30003704.Content: Initiating Routine Inspection No. 258420... Environmental Engram flow stable. Facility structural integrity abnormal...

30003705.Content: Initiating Auto-Calibration... Calibration failed... Uploading report... Upload failed.

30003707.Content: Requesting execution of Banishment Directive... Auto-approval granted.

30003708.Content: Evelyn, find somewhere to hide for now. I'll handle this guy.

30003709.Content: Be careful... If it's too much to handle, we can make a run for it!

30010001.Content: Adventurers, look here-dried <style="emph-gn">fragments of Asteria Cotton</style>... They've been processed.

30010002.Content: Three tools were reported missing by Oliver. Judging by these fibers, this was likely left by the hemp rope.

30010003.Content: But why a rope...? Kidnapping? Or... hanging?!

30010004.Content: So what? Soon, you'll be silenced!

30010005.Content: It is a hemp rope-but there are no signs of struggle. No blood. The rope isn't even stretched.

30010008.Content: Adventurers, I think I hear voices talking nearby!

30010012.Content: Another wave incoming! Hold the line and keep the councilor safe!

30010013.Content: Mission start-repel the enemies and protect the councilor!

30010202.Content:
From Montegnor Valley to the Bahamar Highlands...
and back again to Minsterhorn.
I've seen such beauty, yet I'm shackled by debt, a man without a home.
If I could clear what I owe, I'd return to Minsterhorn and live the quiet life of a farmer...

30010204.Content: (It seems the goblins moved their cargo. These scattered herbs are the key. Let's follow them.)

30010205.Content: (Judging by these ruts, they didn't get far.)

30010206.Content: (Scattered crates lie across the ground-evidence that a caravan once passed through here.)

30010207.Content: (Overturned wagons... The merchants ran into trouble here.)

30010302.Content: The flames are weakening, keep pouring!

30010304.Content: Short on water, head to the dock!

30010305.Content: Water capacity full. Extinguish the fire before collecting more!

30010306.Content: (There's all kinds of folk here. We'll need to get creative if we want them to talk.)

30010307.Content: (This is madness... But he's with the Corps-I can't act recklessly. I'll report to Victor!)

30010310.Content: Time limit reached. Challenge failed. Please try again.

30010314.Content: (Phew... Got the flag. Back to Johnny.)

30010315.Content: (Turns out the goblins just found a random flag... keep searching.)

30010316.Content: (They sure love shiny things. No wonder they hoarded this.)

30010317.Content: (With the matter settled, Johnny was safely escorted by the Asterleeds Defense Corps soldiers to the Statue of the Hero.)

30010401.Content: Oh, never mind. You probably couldn't do it anyway...

30010402.Content: (It's a ring! So shiny. No wonder the goblins were drawn to it.)

30010501.Content: (The scattered wheat grains bore what appeared to be <style="emph-gn">footprints</style>-seemingly human in shape.)

30010502.Content: (It seems <style="emph-gn">highly likely that these footprints were left by a person</style>. Let's follow the scattered wheat and see where it leads.)

30010503.Content: Something doesn't feel right. Let's investigate the area further.

30010504.Content: There he is! Get him, boys!

30010505.Content: Why won't you let me go?

30010506.Content: You adventurers only care about commission. Why are you suddenly so noble?!

30010507.Content: (He seems fixated on the adventurers... Wait, no-!)

30010508.Content: Sorry, adventurers, but I'm taking this wheat...

30010509.Content: If you try to stop me, I will fight back.

30010510.Content: (Wheat was scattered along the road. It looked like Lucien had fled toward the Food District.)

30010511.Content: (Lucien must be hiding in the crowd. Let's track him down.)

30010513.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (8-second countdown)

30010514.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (7-second countdown)

30010515.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (6-second countdown)

30010518.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (3-second countdown)

30010519.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (2-second countdown)

30010520.Content: Bumped into civilians and can't move. Please wait (1-second countdown)

30010602.Content: So, you want to meddle in matters that don't concern you? Then we will have to do it the hard way.

30010603.Content: Damn it... Just wait. I won't forget this!

30010604.Content: (It's finally peaceful again. I should head back and explain the situation to Cove.)

30010607.Content: Not just someone I know... I know him far too well.

30010701.Content: Help! Adventurers! That beast-it's charging right at me!

30010703.Content: Adventurers! Keep it away from me!

30010704.Content: Hey! What are you doing?! Stop that!

30010706.Content: (Whatever he's searching for in the water, I need to break his focus.)

30010708.Content: Ahem... You're quite something... The director was right about you.

30010709.Content: I'll let you go, just this once!

30010801.Content: (We've gathered everything they asked for. Let's head back.)

30010802.Content: (That was more dangerous than I thought. Let's return and talk to Camille.)

30010803.Content:
To Jenny and Camille:
By the time you see this letter, I will have left this world forever. I'm sorry for leaving without saying goodbye.
But I had no choice.
Jenny, you used to be such a cheerful dreamer. I never believed in any so-called dreamland at the time. But under your hopeful influence, I felt empowered every day. However, after you were injured, it felt like you became someone else. I wanted to carry on your dream, Jenny. Even though you always told me not to be bothered with it, I decided to set off alone in search of the perfect land.

But the voyage changed my perspective. When I started to really observe the world around me, I realized how much beauty I had missed.
Just as I was about to return home, I saw how cruel the world could be.

Jenny, Camille, do you know? Our home was the perfect dreamland all along.
I had hoped to tell you this in person, but sadly, I no longer have that chance.

Forever loving you both, Eder

30010805.Content: (They've doubled the guards. I'll have to sneak in carefully.)

30010806.Content: He's back-the one trying to divide us! Don't let him escape this time!

30010808.Content: To harm deceived and innocent civilians-unforgivable!

30010809.Content: (That must be Jenny-Camille's grandmother. Let's approach carefully.)

30010901.Content: Adventurers, look-there! Something's glinting... Could it be Walter's treasure?

30010902.Content: It is a part. Now Walter better cough up some clues.

30011001.Content: This is the site where the most intense engagement during the Andra Landing Battle took place... Tread carefully.

30011002.Content: (Oops! I startled them. No choice now but to fight.)

30011003.Content: (There's no info on Wood here. We'll have to search elsewhere.)

30011004.Content:
[Diary: Part 1]:
It's such an honor to be part of Commander Olvera's team. Whatever the mission, I will not falter!

[Diary: Part 2]:
Never thought Speer would join us too.
The whole corps is nervous about the terrifying strength of Byrnhald, but that guy-he's always so carefree.
The Byrnhald forces land tomorrow... I ought to steel myself like him!

[Diary: Part 3]:
(Text obscured by crimson stains, illegible.)

30011005.Content: (This might be Wood's journal. We should ask Brown.)

30011006.Content: (This must be the flag Speer was looking for.)

30011008.Content: (Just more reflective stones under the sand. Keep searching...)

30011010.Content:
Hello, stranger! I'm a friend from Montegnor Valley.
This is my first time playing with message bottles. If you found this, may all the best things find you, too.
And if you're interested-drop by the valley. You're most welcome!

30011011.Content: (Just a regular message bottle... Let's keep looking.)

30011012.Content: (This feeling... Could it be-an Imagine Seed?)

30011013.Content: (Oh no... Arachnocrabs. A whole nest of them.)

30011014.Content: (As I suspected... These are condensed Imagine Seeds. The Arachnocrabs must've dug them out.)

30011015.Content: (Either way, we should bring this to Brown.)

30011202.Content: (This part's loose. That might be the problem.)

30011302.Content: Sorry, everyone... I can't walk anymore.

30011303.Content: Stay strong! Goblins could strike at any second!

30011401.Content: I'm next to the cabbage field! Can't you see me?

30011402.Content: Still no luck? I'm hiding inside the water tank under the largest windmill!

30011403.Content: I'm behind the fruit and vegetable stand, near the notice board!

30011701.Content: (This luxury vehicle boasts exquisite Artisanship. Its seat cushions were velvet, stitched with delicate embroidery and studded with glimmering crystals-a clear mark of nobility)

30011801.Content: (Wait... Is that someone lying in front?)

30011804.Content: The Brigands... they went mad... the streetlights... they wanted to... kidnap me...

The draft was filled with strange symbols and complex calculations.
In the bottom corner, three words were circled in red: Caprahorn Induction Device, Delay Device, and Array 15.

30011806.Content: (The footprints... they continue up the rock wall...)

Asterleeds Ecological Monitoring Team

II. Biological observation: Organism activity along the water
III. Moss survey: Health check of cliffside moss to evaluate its resilience.
