I have lost my beloved Treasure
and need help urgently!
Generous reward for any adventurer who finds it.
Interested parties, please come to The Spinning Rudder.
-"Little Rose"

30012203.Content: Wow... I really want to buy so many clothes at once...

30012206.Content: Why does it all suddenly make sense the moment you see it?

30012207.Content: Because... it's a special cat. Very special.

30012209.Content: (The only place Treasure truly wants to go... it's probably Minsterhorn.)

30012301.Content: (Looks like Asterleeds Defense Corps is engaged in reconnaissance exercises.)

30012303.Content: (This doesn't feel like lightning... I should tell Cian.)

30012501.Content: (Wait, is that a child over there? Let's see if he picked up the speech script.)

30012503.ChatName: The first page of the speech script
30012503.Content:
Distinguished councilors, esteemed colleagues, and fellow citizens,
my name is Eddie Hopson, a proud native of Minsterhorn. Though my roots lie there, I have spent many fulfilling years here in Asterleeds, and over time, I have developed a deep and lasting emotional bond with this land.
It is precisely because of that bond that drives me to make the soil that raised me better.
... (Some pages are too damaged to decipher after being chewed by the dog for too long.)




Page 1 of 5

30012504.Content: Right here-two pages of the speech script got blown onto the roof! Can't reach them... You're my only hope!

30012505.ChatName: The second page of the speech script
30012505.Content:
Before I begin, allow me to mention two heroes of the Asterleeds Independence War-Tina and Olvera.
Their deeds inspired this proposal. What I'm about to say is rooted in their legacy.

During the Asterleeds Independence War, we gave our all to resist the Byrnhald forces, despite being vastly outnumbered.
And none shone brighter than these two legends on every battlefield: Tina and Olvera.
It was said that wherever they fought, victory followed.
But it wasn't just their strength.
It was the spirit of Asterleeds they embodied.
Our hunger for freedom. Our unbreakable will. We can see them in the heroes who rose during the war.
That spirit helped us achieve the impossible.




Page: 2/5

30012506.ChatName: The third page of the speech script
30012506.Content:
However, will is a fragile force, shaped and tested by the weight of emotion and reality.
Warriors of Asterleeds draw strength from glimpses of their champions' battlefield valor,
reminding themselves that even foes mightier than themselves can be defeated.

But today, in the prosperity of Asterleeds, that spirit is fading at an alarming rate.




Page: 3/5

30012507.ChatName: The fourth page of the speech script
30012507.Content:
What have we done since the war ended?
We've drowned ourselves in entertainment. Food District songs are louder than ever.
We praise our progress-the Artisan Guild forging "truth" with every strike.
We trust our strength-thinking Asterleeds Defense Corps soldiers' boots alone will keep enemies away.
But the danger never left. We still depend on Byrnhald for trade.
Behind the celebration lies a hard truth:
We rely too heavily on Byrnhald. If we were to lose them as a trading partner, our markets would suffer greatly.


This looming crisis likely stems from the loss of our wartime spirit. We may appear to be free.
But the Byrnhald's chains still tighten around our necks, unseen yet unbroken.

Now rumors of rising taxes shake the streets.
The fact that one mere whisper has caused such panic? This absurdity is nothing but a warning.




Page: 4/5

30012508.Content:
(A grimy medal, judging by its size, likely hung around livestock's neck.
Long neglected, now rusted beyond recognition.
Engraved with a few lines of words.)


Awarded to Billy for Most Majestic Horns during Livestock Division Champion of
the 11th Annual Pastoral Championship
-Raised by the Hobson Family

30012509.ChatName: The fifth page of the speech script
30012509.Content:
Wake up, Asterians!
The spirit of the Asterleeds Independence War may have faded, but it's not gone entirely.
As long as we're willing to face the truth, there's still a chance to rebuild our confidence.
From a young age, I was taught: "Start with small things."
So here is my proposal-Let's develop animal husbandry! Let's stop letting Byrnhald hold us hostage over food.
Not so long ago, the domesticated Caprahorns of Minsterhorn once won the agricultural championship.
The Caprahorns that roam the Asteria Plains are our natural advantage.

Of course, livestock farming is just the beginning. But it might be the right place to start.
I'm just an ordinary citizen. And this is what I see, and what I hope to change.

Apologies for taking up your time, esteemed councilors. Please allow my proposal to linger in your minds for just a little while.
Perhaps it will stir some thought, or perhaps it will simply fade away.
I'm Eddie Hopson from Minsterhorn, and I'd be honored to do something for Asterleeds.




Page: 5/5

30012510.Content: Hey adventurers-come back to Minsterhorn sometime and hang out with me! Had a blast today!

30012511.Content:
Good morning, councilors, advisors, and citizens. I am Eddie Hopson, from Minsterhorn.
I've lived in Asterleeds for many years. This city means a great deal to me.
And it's precisely because of that bond that I want to make this land that raised me even better.
...
Before I begin, please allow me to mention two heroes of the Asterleeds Independence War: Tina and Olvera.
Their deeds inspired this proposal. What I'm about to say is rooted in their legacy.

During the Asterleeds Independence War, we gave our all to resist the Byrnhald forces, despite being vastly outnumbered.
And none shone brighter than these two legends on every battlefield: Tina and Olvera.
It was said that wherever they fought, victory followed.

But it wasn't just their strength.
It was the spirit of Asterleeds they embodied.
Our hunger for freedom. Our unbreakable will. We can see them in the heroes who rose during the war.
That spirit helped us achieve the impossible.

However, will is a fragile force, shaped and tested by the weight of emotion and reality.
Warriors of Asterleeds draw strength from glimpses of their champions' battlefield valor,
reminding themselves that even foes mightier than themselves can be defeated.

But today, in the prosperity of Asterleeds, that spirit is fading at an alarming rate.

What have we done since the war ended?
We've drowned ourselves in entertainment. Food District songs are louder than ever.
We praise our progress—the Artisan Guild forging "truth" with every strike.
We trust our strength—thinking Asterleeds Defense Corps soldiers' boots alone will keep enemies away.
But the danger never left. We still depend on Byrnhald for trade.
Behind the celebration lies a hard truth:
We rely too heavily on Byrnhald.

Perhaps this potential crisis is precisely because the spirit of the Independence War has been lost.

30012701.Content: (Anyway, let's tell Charlie about this first.)

30012702.Content:
The Gigantic Automaton, ancient and formidable creations forged by the Bapharians, were pivotal during the war against the dragons.
According to legend, these colossal machines were not reclaimed by the Divine, but rather, scattered and lost throughout the corners of the Continent of Magna.
The Divine's texts reveal that each Gigantic Automaton can only be activated by a chosen user.

30013301.Content: The fishing spot I've marked is situated at the source of <style="emph-gn">Pale Azure Lake</style>. I've spent a long time observing from a distance, and I'm certain it's a fertile spot, teeming with fish.

30013302.Content: Though I've entrusted you with my escort, don't push yourself too hard. You are still young, after all.

30013304.Content: Let's head northwest. We're almost there.

30013401.Content: The wind-driven Seal Watchers sounds a low rumble... Wind...Seal Watchers...

30013402.Content: The waves shimmer in the sunlight... golden...

30013403.Content: There's something hidden beneath the turmoil, some secret buried in the most turbulent depths... the most turbulent...

30013405.Content: Wait no-think deeper. What does "most turbulent" truly imply...?

30013406.Content:
Driven by the wind, the Seal Watcher rumbles ominously.
(The hand-drawn treasure map shows three marked locations forming a triangle around a village - likely Minsterhorn.)

30013407.Content:
They gaze upon the golden wave,
and hide the secret beneath the fiercest tide.
(The map shows patches of "golden wave," with a large treasure chest marked in the center of the biggest one.)

30013601.Content: (How mysterious... What exactly is the Shadow of Bapharian? Perhaps I should ask those people standing over there.)

30013602.Content: <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>! You handle this one. I'm going to take care of the other little thief!

30013603.Content: Hey, you over there! Don't run! Stop right there!

30013701.Content: (Wait, did I just hear them mention the Blaze Gang? Could they be involved in something?)

30013702.Content: (We need to investigate, just to be safe.)

30013901.Content: (Let's float up along this wind field and take a closer look.)

30013903.Content: (Fido... It seems it's picked up the scent of its master from the top of this ring device.)

30013904.Content:
The Ruins of Andra City, once ruled by the Bapharian Divines, now lie before me, an awe-inspiring sight.
How magnificent, how exhilarating!
The records in the Bapharian Creed's doctrine didn't exaggerate. This is, without a doubt, a masterpiece left behind by the Bapharian Divines.
The Artisanship in this ring-shaped device is beyond belief-it defies the natural laws in ways I cannot comprehend.
It's truly a work of the divine. The Divine' creations surpass all imagination. I long to see more.
Too many unsolved mysteries surround the Divine's existence-perhaps this journey will unveil some of their secrets. If so, my life will not have been lived in vain!

30013906.Content: (It seems Fido's sensed something once again. Let's follow it and see what it's found.)

30013908.Content: (It seems that Fido has sensed hostility?!)

30013909.Content: (Next, let's see what Fido has discovered.)

30013910.Content:
Strange.
Very strange.
This city-once so powerful-has been reduced to ruin.
The destruction is clear. The damage to these homes is unmistakably the result of war.
How could a city under the protection of the Divine fall to such devastation?
Was there an enemy more powerful than the Bapharian Divines?
No... that's impossible.
The truth must lie beyond what is apparent, and I am determined to uncover it.

30013914.Content: (Great. That's the third one now... and still, no sign of Grace.)

30013915.Content:
So that's the truth... After reading the records inscribed in these ancient scrolls, everything makes sense now.
No wonder ​Void Engram plagues this place-no wonder even a mighty city-state ruled by the Divine fell.
Their prosperity... it was built on something too disturbing to name...
if this knowledge is real-then what will become of our world? I can't bring myself to think further...
But it's too late to take any of this back. The Void Engram coils around me now...
Still... perhaps it's better this way. My thirst for truth is quenched. As for the future... I no longer wish to see it. I'm tired. Let me rest.

30013917.Content: (Why is he running? It's dangerous here. I have to bring Fido back.)

30013919.Content: (It's Grace. He's... he's been eroded by the Void Corruption.)

30013920.Content: The truth... such a terrible truth!

30013923.Content: (Poor Fido... I have to return. I have to tell Sandro what happened)

30014101.Content: (This must be... Aged Purple Bellflower mentioned by Bru.)

30014102.Content: (Found it. And this-yes, it's the Void Arachnocrab's Sac! Bru will want this back.)

30014901.Content: (Isn't that... the "General Cat"? Could the other three cats be with him too?)

30014902.Content: (A flowerpot, knocked from a great height... Judging by the direction of the fragments, I might be able to trace where the suspect fled.)

30014903.Content: (And these scratch marks on the lower part of the door-they're deliberate. A clever cat used them to get someone to open it. If I follow the direction...)

30014904.Content: (It sniffs you politely, tail wagging, gaze drifting toward the beach, eyes glinting with what seems like longing. There's a small claw mark on its nose.)

30015101.Content: Let me see, the first item on the list is... collect a water sample from Pale Azure Lake.

30015102.Content: This should be enough. It looks so clear, doesn't seem to have been affected much by the war.

30015103.Content: Next up is... catching a fish from Pale Azure Lake?

30015104.Content: The last job: collect Asteria Cotton...

30015105.Content: This plant usually grows around water sources and, to some extent, reflects the water quality.

30015106.Content: Alright, done! Let's go back and find Kobo!

30015201.Content:
A distant whirlpool had begun pulling the ship into its spiral grip.
Several cargo holds were punctured by jagged reefs beneath the surface.
Though we managed to pitch up the breached sections, most of the cloth cargo sustained irreversible water damage...

The captain tried to reassure us: once we passed through this treacherous basin, the journey would be safe.

But what are our true odds against these murderous currents?
Outside, the wind howls. The Merchant Guild scrambles to assess the mounting losses.
According to prior agreements, this disaster will likely spark serious disputes...

All we can do now is pray-to escape this sea alive.

30015202.Content:
The mast has been shattered!
Fights have broken out among some crew members over fresh water-desperation has turned them into predators, eyes gleaming like starving wolves.
...
(Several lines are obscured by ink)
...
The cargo hold's barrier has burst again. Even now, the Merchant Guild is debating how to salvage what remains...
But the hull continues to groan and tremble, dragged mercilessly toward the heart of the vortex. Can we ever survive it?

30015203.Content:
Our food is nearly gone.
The freighter is inching ever closer to the center of the maelstrom...
It feels like escape is no longer an option.
I thought I saw a flicker of light deep within the whirlpool's core. Maybe it was only my mind playing tricks in despair...

If anyone finds this letter-please, carry my final blessings to my family.

Forever yours...
(The rest of the writing is water-damaged beyond recognition)

30015302.Content:
Dear little Aiden,
By the time you open this letter, I should have already left Minsterhorn,
and you should have grown into a young man capable of protecting yourself, right?

The truth is, your brother isn't going on a grand adventure.
I've contracted a rare illness, and there's no good treatment for it right now.
I didn't want you and parents to see me taking medicine, so I've been hiding it from you all.

You're a grown-up now, you can protect yourself and our parents.
I heard there's a secret remedy that can cure diseases somewhere in the north, and that's the purpose of my journey.

But don't worry about me. I'll come back as soon as I'm cured.
Until then, you must take care of Mom and Dad for me, and protect our home.
I've buried a gift for you under the tree next to our house. Remember to go get it.

May the Time Locket protect you.

Isa

30016001.Content: Damn it, the device activated suddenly! The delayed timer must have triggered it...

30016002.Content: Adventurers, I think I smell a monster! Please-protect me!

30020102.Content: (The scholar from earlier has vanished. We should head back to the camp and investigate.)

30020201.Content: We're close. It should be just up ahead.

30020202.Content: Looks like someone's over there. Adventurers, let's check it out.

30020401.Content: (I've already asked everyone I could find... I guess all that's left is to take Airona's advice and try my luck at the Pioneer Bureau.)

30020402.Content: (A footprint. Still fresh. Someone passed through here recently.)

30020403.Content: (The scuffed ground suggests a conflict occurred. Footsteps trail in all directions, long strides as though they were fleeing.)

30020501.Content: (Looks like a fading shoe print-left here long ago.)

30020502.Content: (Some burn marks-signs they camped here for a while. Let's have a look around.)

30020503.Content: (Strange. Seems there's something buried beneath this stone...)

30020504.Content:
...
Not the right time yet. Damn Swindler. That bastard's really good at hiding who he is.
The problem is, we don't have enough evidence to bring him down yet. All we need is proof that he rented my boat that day. That's it. Until then, we can't report him-God knows how many of his people are in the Corps or even on the Council.
I can't believe I was stupid enough to fall for his act. Just because he offered a little extra cash, I let him use the boat without even signing a contract.
...
And now... Mom's illness is getting worse. She can't even speak clearly anymore. This damn accusation of treason has ruined everything. I can't be an adventurer. I can't even go back to my old job!
I need money. A lot of it.
...
There's really no other way. The forest survey team is hiring guides. It'll take a week to make what I need for Mom's treatment. I know that area well. This might be my last shot.
Carter keeps trying to talk me out of it. Says it's too dangerous. He's not wrong-if it wasn't, the reward wouldn't be so high.
Before I left, I gave all the evidence I had to my best buddy Carter. I told him, if I don't come back... at least I don't want people calling me a traitor. I'm not. I'm not!
...
We set off. So far, it's gone pretty smoothly.
The team has vast experience, they aren't called the survey team for nothing. The route the ecologists picked helped us avoid almost all the monsters. Amazing.
There's this guy, Ryan (I think that's his name?), who joined last minute like me. He keeps accidentally attracting monsters. The captain already chewed him out once.
...
Now the wind's starting to pick up. It's been dark all day. If it starts pouring, we're in trouble. We lit a fire to keep the monsters away-windy nights always stir them up.
Luckily, there's a camp nearby. The team's got multiple overnight spots set up in the valley just for this kind of weather. We're crashing here tonight.

30020505.Content:
(The text above has been soaked and is no longer legible.)
...
We are stuck. According to meteorological patterns, this wind doesn't seem natural. The team's ecologist suspects it's the work of goblins.
Dark clouds have begun to form in the distance, rolling in from the sea. That's not a good sign. If the goblins are up to some weird ritual and it clashes with the seasonal storms, things could get really bad...
The monsters' howls echo from all directions. I'm glad we've already altered our route. There are still some supplies left at Station No. 6. It's on high ground, so it won't flood. We can hide there for a while.

...

The young guy traveling with us, named Roy, has gone missing.

...

Everyone's doing their best, but the wind now is strong enough to snap trees. The team can barely communicate. If we don't return to Station No. 6 soon, things will get trickier.
We found his backpack near a tree by the cliff, along with some messy footprints. Ryan guessed he might've slipped and fallen. Let's hope he survives.
No one really knows where Roy came from. He wasn't a formally registered adventurer. Other than erecting a cenotaph by the tree outside the station, there isn't much we can do.

...

The storm is coming...

30020506.Content: (No further clues here. But Carter seems to know more than he's letting on-let's circle back and question him in Port Town.)

30020701.Content: I know where he is. Swindler usually hides by the beach at this hour.

30020702.Content: The mastermind is still at large, and the people are suffering... I've failed them as Council Chair.

30020703.Content: Don't let Swindler get away! He's trying to escape by yacht!

30020704.Content: I'll leave this to you I'm going after him!

30020705.Content: (They're running toward the docks... I have to help Carter...)

30020801.Content:
Thank goodness there were other adventurers around to help me out. Without them, I wouldn't have made it into Everfall Forest at all.
The air's really damp tonight. It feels like it might rain later. I can't stay out in the open for too long. I need to find a place to camp soon.
Honestly, right now I just want to curl up somewhere and eat Mom's stew...
Sander is licking my hand nonstop. You're thirsty too, huh? Let's find some water and give you a bath too.
I've got 2 pieces of bread left and a moonfruit another adventurer gave me. Should be enough to get through the night. I'll look for more food tomorrow.
... (The writing gets hard to read here-it's smudged and messy.)
We should keep moving for...
(The page is torn off after this point.)

30020802.Content:
I want to go home. I want to go home. I want to go home. I want to go home!
There are monsters everywhere! My leg still hurts from the scratches. I just want Mom's cooking... I just want to sleep in my warm bed with Sander!
Why can't I find the exit?! Why?!

30020803.Content:
If anyone finds this, please help me. I don't know where I am. I'm surrounded by ruins.
A monster attacked us and I got hurt-I can't walk anymore...
I managed to crawl into a crevice between the ruins and the valley to hide... but I know it's only a matter of time before I'm discovered...
I gave this letter to Sander and told it to find someone-anyone-who could help...
If you're reading this... please save me...

30020804.Content:
I couldn't find a camp. No water, no food. Not even fruit. And weirdly, not a single monster either.
According to adventurers outside, the monsters in Everfall Forest are far more ferocious, but I haven't seen any, just a few wild rabbits running around.
The forest is way too quiet at night... it's actually kinda scary. Thank god Sander's with me.
Still, thinking about that thing being out there... gives me a weird burst of energy!
...
If I can find it and give it to Aishe, she'll definitely agree to watch the fireworks at Asterleeds Beach with me! You bet!
Sander's already dozed off next to me. I should rest too-save my strength for tomorrow. Still need to find food, water, and then head deeper in the search of that thing...
...
I could've sworn I heard something just now. Maybe I'm just overtired...
There are some ruins up the hill to the east... Maybe I can find something useful there.
Maybe that thing is...
(The rest of the writing is smudged-probably slobbered on by Sander.)

30020805.Content:
Mom, I'm sorry. I don't think I can make it back...
The wounds on my body have begun to fester, but strangely, I don't feel any pain. Perhaps a small mercy in this grim situation.
There's no food in my backpack. I didn't want Sander to die here with me, so I sent it ahead with a message for help...
I know no one will ever come to a place like this. I should've listened to you and stayed home...
Mom, I'm sorry. I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry...
...
Mom, you probably will never read this...
If anyone finds this letter, could you please do me a favor?
There are two of my diaries buried under a tree in Minsterhorn. Please deliver the red one to Ms. Mary in town, and the white one to Aishe near the shop...
...
Maybe now... I can finally rest...
...
May love stay in this world forever...
Yael

30020806.Content:
I was awakened by the rain. I thought I'd reached heaven, but I was still in this hell.
Suddenly I saw the bracelet Mom made for me slide out of my backpack. Sadness instantly jolted me back to clarity.
I realized I can't die here yet...
Sander has been gone a long time. It must have reached somewhere safe by now. I have to hold on until the rescuers arrive.
But I have no food or water. I saw smoke rising in the north. Maybe there's a camp there.
My wounds seem to be starting to heal a little. I hope the last of the bandages in my backpack can get me that far...
...
Yes! I can do this! Mom! Wait for me!
And Ai...
(The paper is too torn and the writing below is no longer visible.)

30021001.Content: Next up is the second Control Panel.

30021002.Content: Then the third. Pay attention to how I tell you to operate it.

30021003.Content:
Hills,
By the time you read this, I might already be taken by the Creed's enforcers or the duchy's military police.
I've hidden all my research in the usual place.
You once told me I should give up-that nothing good comes from going against the Creed. But once the edict was issued, I knew I was right to push forward.
You're probably calling me stubborn again...
Perhaps I am wrong, but as we both know, only history will deliver the final verdict on us. What scares me more than being wrong is
how history suddenly comes to an abrupt halt at a certain point-as if all that came before had ceased to exist.
Hills, I truly believe: if you don't know where you come from, you'll never know where you're going.
If you're willing to keep going, take my research to Asterleeds. Maybe the Ruins of Andra City on the Asteria Plains still bear echoes of a lost civilization.
But if you can't... I get it. This road is hard. Maybe too hard. If that's the case, just forget this letter.
Looking back, I think my happiest moments were those quiet afternoons at the institute, sorting through dusty documents with you.
All the best.
-Azik

30030019.ChatName: Exploring the buried secrets of Windhowl Canyon—Scholar Team Recruitment Announcement
30030019.Content:
The brilliance of the past lies quietly among the ruins.

The Continent of Magna is steeped in history, once home to civilizations that glittered like the stars.

To rediscover the glory and wisdom of these lost worlds, we, a team of elite scholars from every field, are preparing for a groundbreaking expedition, combining rigorous research and cutting-edge methods to explore and interpret ancient ruins.



Recruitment Categories:

Scholars (Filled)
Historians, ecologists, ancient language specialists, etc.

Craftsmen (Filled)
Experts in heritage preservation, excavation, and equipment support.

Adventurers (Urgently Needed!!!)
Dangerous monsters still lurk in the canyon. We need skilled survivors and seasoned fighters.
You'll escort scholars, help set up camps, and support site investigations.

Archivists (Filled)
Manage data, maintain equipment, and organize records. Some survival skills required.
Bonus if you can cook!


How to Join: Head to the first floor of Ocean Hill and speak with Mr. Smith, the expedition leader.
Merchants with funds not accepted.
Frio School applicants will be turned away.

30040807.Content:
Chapter 6.3: Origins of the Webber Energy Network

The lead artisan was named "Webber."
Although the use of Legacies was limited at the time, Webber was determined to design an energy network system for the city.

The idea was bold and forward-thinking—by integrating the energy network from the very start of construction, he laid a solid foundation for the widespread use of Legacies in present-day Asterleeds.
Today in Asterleeds, everything from cooking appliances in wealthy households to ventilation systems in restaurants...
even lighting and signage infrastructure all rely on the energy network designed by Webber to function properly.

To honor the dedication of these artisans and Webber's visionary work,
Asterleeds's energy system was officially renamed "Webber."
This admirable group of artisans became known as the unique Architects, and many remain active within the Artisan Guild to this day.

Alician calendar, June 18, Year ■■■

Even after so many years, with a new family, a new identity.
Those events are still etched in my mind.

Always at the most difficult, most critical moments...

And the ■■ Abyssal Eye!
To ■■ with all of you!
I'm gonna live! I'm gonna live! I'm gonna live!

30051008.Content: Found it! Adventurer, come look! There's a passage etched here!

30051009.Content:
To those who seek the Abyssal Eye! Heed my words!
The great pirate Heathcliff briefly possessed it.

But even with my status, I couldn't suppress its evil power!
First, the ship was wrecked, and we fell into this underwater sac cave.
Then the monsters of the deep were drawn to it!
My crew, my treasure, all swallowed whole...

Avenge me and finish what I could not!
If you can slay that sea monster, the jewel is yours.

(Below is a roughly drawn map, with a dotted line ending in an X.)
The monster's lair
To summon it, you need the heavy scent of many skyfish.
Don't ask me how I know. I don't want to relive my failed revenge.

30051010.Content: What was that sound... Be careful!

30051017.Content: This is bad... Get out of the way!

30051101.Content: (This should do it... Next is brine.)

30051102.Content: Who would collect brine alone in such a dangerous place? Well, the quality seems good.

30051104.Content: But don't get cocky. Soon, you'll see what we're really capable of.

30051601.Content: (Hmm... is this cobalt liquid from when the workers were cutting the anemones?)

30051602.Content: (Oh no... It must be this liquid that's affecting my mind.)

30051603.Content: (I need to find a way to break free from its control!)

30051604.Content: Strange, the Anemone Workers seem to be coming to their senses too.

30051605.Content: (The Anemone Workers here seem quite normal. Let's ask if they've encountered any anemone Anomalys.)

30051702.Content: (Hmm... there are this many? I should go ask Dorunik)

30051703.Content: (There they are! Those few were Ereka's underlings last time)

30051704.Content: (I'd better find a place to eavesdrop on what they're up to...)

30051705.Content: (This spot works. Just need to drive off the nearby monsters first...)

30052101.Content:
(A hide scroll made of Skyfish skin, with a few crudely scrawled lines on it)
"Hey! Whoever stole my brine, I'm coming to settle the score!
Last time I lost because I wasn't at my best and couldn't give it my all!
But now I've found a way to definitely beat you!
I challenge you to a rematch at the third reef south of the cave!
So what do you say? Got the guts to show up?!

If you're too scared...
Just pickle yourself and feed yourself to the Skyfish. Save me the trouble of tracking you down!"

-Wilbert
(At the bottom is a doodle of a little stick figure being stabbed with a dagger. The figure's eyes are drawn as two X's.)

30052102.Content: Boss! Someone's coming! Is it the one?!

30052103.Content: I thought someone wouldn't show up. Get ready to welcome our guest, boys!

30052104.Content: So, can you smell that new scent in the air?

30052105.Content: It might be hard to tell the first time... but the scent of wounds is always the clearest.

30052106.Content: Keep sniffing! You'll soon know exactly where they are...

30052107.Content: Ugh... this is a bit awkward. These monsters stink so much they're messing up the scent.

30052108.Content: Clear out a few before moving forward!

30052109.Content: Alright, now we can keep moving.

30052110.Content: Look, those people over there seem to be talking about something...

30052111.Content: Whoa, they actually hid their secret base here? Pretty clever...

30052112.Content: That pungent smell in the air... No doubt they're hiding brine kegs inside.

30052113.Content: Adventurer, let's split up and search. We might find clues to reveal their true purpose.

30052114.ChatName: Captain Livera's One-Act Play Notes Part I
30052114.Content:
Act One: Dirge of Fate in the Rusted Iron Coffin

Oh! This iron coffin kissed by the Abyssal (Note: refers to a secure wooden crate) has spat out a piece of parchment!
"Sulfurfire dances with the salt crystals, and the abyssal gate shall kneel to the madman."
What a magnificent opening verse!
Wilbert's trembling growl is more moving than the wails of a seagull:
"Captain, this must be Heathcliff Stormwrath's love letter to destiny!"
Let the parasites keep sneering!
When my brine bombs sound their overture,
their hypocrisy will be shattered with the coral throne!
(Wildly scrawled note: Wilbert suggested stuffing the explosives in pickled fish kegs. He has been punished to lick barnacles off the mast.)

30052115.ChatName: Captain Livera's One-Act Play Notes Part II
30052115.Content:
Act Three: Duet of Salt and Scabs

Third time! The third time! The crystals betrayed me again at the final moment!
(Smashes the flask, and glass shards scatter like applause after a show)
The salt grains cured in tidal brine were meant to ignite the fire of chaos, yet they've turned into sticky poison!
(Lifts a failed batch with the tip of a sword)
Look! This blue curse bore pearls in Ereka's hands...
(Suddenly lowers voice)
Maybe I should sell this to one of those noble Asterleeds ladies?
Title: Let The Ashes of Your Enemies Nourish Your Beauty...
No! My ambition shall never be reduced to some landlubber's beauty ad!

30052116.ChatName: Captain Livera's One-Act Play Notes Part III
30052116.Content:
Act Five: Satirical Interlude of the Dove and the Brine Keg

Miss Ereka's spies are more annoying than a shark's gums!
(Draws an eyepatch-wearing dove with wine stains)
Ereka actually dreams of wrapping every pirate fang in a white flag!
After she took over, Ereka made some "Seafaring Pact" with that fool Raoul.
"No attacking landfolk proactively."
Come on, pirates without violence are like rain without wet! Absurd!
She must've forgotten what being a pirate means.
And she's forgotten why we came here in the first place.
We came to this cave to find the legendary Siren's Tear.
And now? It's just her private stash!

30052117.ChatName: Captain Livera's One-Act Play Notes Part IV
30052117.Content:
Final Chapter: Solo Encore of the Blue Flame

It's done! It's done! (scrawled handwriting)
When the compressed salt block burst into ghostly blue flames,
all the Skyfish in the cave leaped into a waltz of escape!
A deep crater was blasted into the reef in the cave!
Thus, the mission to search for Siren's Tear is within reach!

What's the big deal if Wilbert's dentures flew off?
By this time tomorrow, the legendary Siren's Tear will bring me an entire fleet!

(A spotlight shines on Asterleeds.
The background echoes with the roar of 37 ceremonial cannons.
Ereka's white-flag ship turns to confetti on cue)

-The End-

30060201.Content: (Hmm... These unique footprints... They seems to belong to Goblins.)

30060203.Content: (Looks like the blasted "thief" escaped by climbing over this cliff face.)

30060204.Content: Hey, Adventurer! Hey, over here, over here!

30060205.Content: How despicable, to climb in from here.

30060206.Content: A-adventurer! Quick! That nasty goblin just appeared!

30062101.Content:
To the Passing Traveler:
The path ahead grows treacherous. We can no longer carry this heavy gear, so we have left these cooking utensils and rations here. If you need them, please take what you wish. May they aid you on your journey.
A Band of Wanderers

30062401.Content:
Dear {*me.name*},
I trust this letter finds you well.
I hear you have journeyed to the Bahamar Highlands. I hope your travels are proceeding smoothly.
I spent some time there during my travels across the continent. The highland's unique topography is truly breathtaking. Those towering crystal pillars bursting from the bedrock in myriad shapes... some resemble blooming flowers, don't they?
But to the matter at hand: I wish to request that you visit a friend on my behalf—Evelyn. She is a scholar specializing in the flow of Engram, and I was greatly indebted to her kindness during my stay in the highland.
Evelyn used to reside in Lallipar, but she spends most of her time out in the field conducting research. I fear you may need to ask the villagers for her whereabouts.
Though I long to return to the highland and meet her myself, my health no longer permits such a journey.
Enclosed is a letter addressed to Evelyn. Please deliver it to her for me.
Your loyal friend,
Sid

30062402.Content: Ask the villagers nearby for Evelyn's whereabouts.

30062501.Content: Next, go gather an Umu Fruit.

30062502.Content: That should do it, return to Tormund.

30064901.Content: (There are a ton of monsters around. I'll have to clear them out while I search.)

30064902.Content: (There's a vague human silhouette over there... Could it be Flavia?)

30070201.Content: Adventurer, look! Over there, that person is exhausted and sitting on the ground.

30070202.Content: There are too many Goblins nearby. Adventurer, you'll have to take out some monsters to get close to him.

30070203.Content: (Hmm, this should be close enough to him now.)

30070204.Content: What a wonderful scent... Adventurer, the Muku shouldn't attack you now. Go on.

30070205.Content: Excellent, the perfume is working. Now, try to make friendly contact with them.

30070301.Content:
Have you ever noticed those travelers known as Scavengers?
They refuse to be bound by the mundane world, wandering freely like the wind.
They carry their entire belongings in bulging packs,
hurrying through alleys and vanishing quietly into the crowds.
Their lives are like fallen leaves drifting in the wind,
brushing past the world, free yet lonely.

My name is Zek, and I'm journeying across the continent of Regnus as a scavenger.
After a long trek, my companions and I finally arrived at the Asteria Plains.
We heard of a mysterious forest there called the Duskdye Woods .
We wanted to explore it while visiting some fellow scavenger friends who live there.
However, that forest is full of dangers, with monsters roaming and Brigands lurking.

For safety's sake, I'm now recruiting a brave adventurer to escort us.
If you're interested, find the man with a giant backpack named Zek near the Pioneer Bureau.
The contact phrase: "Hey Zek, found any treasures today?"

Rest assured, the reward will be ample.

30070303.Content: Look, still as many monsters as ever...

30070304.Content: Time for adventurers to shine! Please clear out some of these monsters for us.

30070305.Content: Yeah, so we can sneak past along the edge... See you in a bit!

30070307.Content: Whoa... This path is so narrow. It's a bit scary.

30070308.Content: If you're that scared, we shouldn't have come this way to begin with.

30070401.Content: Mission complete! You're looking much younger now!

30070402.Content: But remember-the effect is time-limited, so we'd better move quickly.

30070403.Content: I'll stay hidden nearby to keep watch while you investigate.

30070404.Content: Hey, you're walking too much like an adult... Imagine how a child walks.

30070405.Content: I can't seem to hear the detective's voice anymore. Did I go too far...

30070406.Content: Where... where am I... Was I attacked by the culprit?

30070407.Content: Damn it... I can't remember that person's face at all... Whatever, I need to save the child first!

30070501.Content: (I don't see any Crimson mushroom. Wait... what's that?)

30070502.Content: (Looks like it stopped breathing a while ago. Could it be related to the Crimson mushroom?)

30070503.Content: (Damn... I think I've angered a monster!)

30070802.Content: I didn't expect this. An adventurer. It seems my luck has turned.

30070805.Content: Why aren't you panicking at all? Don't you want to catch that Brazer member anymore?

30070806.Content: Because we already anticipated this... Just wait and enjoy the show.

3010001.Content: Look, the sea looks great today!

3010003.Content:
File Number: S-23-06-A1

Report Time: Alician Calendar Year 600, June ■■■, 03:20

Reporter: Deputy Commander Jerrad

Urgency: Red Flag

At 02:10 today, The Bapharian Guard Post was attacked by the Dark Mist Legion.

The enemy took advantage of our unpreparedness and broke through the outer defenses, with an estimated force of about two hundred soldiers.

The combat strength of the Bapharian Guard Post is less than 30%, requesting higher-level support.

3010004.Content: These are the soldiers stationed here... What happened...

3010007.Content:
To {*me.name*}:

While investigating the village, I discovered some unusual phenomena. If you encounter them, be careful!

Crackling electric walls: Don't force your way through, you'll get electrocuted!
There's a crack in the wall. The electric power is weaker there.

Shiny monsters: More ferocious than before, they actively electrocute people!

These monsters drop electrified glowing objects. I call them lightning orbs.
Just carry those little balls, and the crack in the electric wall will become fragile, making it easy to break through. That's how I went inside and rescued everyone!

3010008.Content: (The further we go, the stronger the electric power...)

3010009.Content: (These monsters' electrics are getting stronger. Narulu should stay away.)

3010013.Content:
N-no, it's nothing.
Just calling your name makes me feel at ease.

3010014.Content: (Deprecated) (Although this child acts tough, he must be scared facing such danger...)

3010015.Content: (Deprecated) (I need to find a way to stop the lightning storm ASAP.)

3010016.Content: (Deprecated) There's a glowing orb up ahead!

3010017.Content: (Deprecated) That must be the Lightning Storm Core.

3010103.Content: Leave this place! The evil flames will consume us...!

3010104.Content: (What happened in the camp that drove the priests to flee?)

3010105.Content: (This appears to be a Dark Mist Legion weapons crate, but the weapons inside are extremely worn. Would anyone bring such deteriorated weapons into combat...?)

3010111.Content: It's the Dark Mist Legion! Airona and the others are in danger!

3010112.Content: Hold fast-Andra Resting Post is just ahead. Keep moving. Thank you...

3010113.Content: These pests never quit! We're counting on you to fight back once more,<style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>!

3010114.Content: It's a Dark Mist Legion's snare-watch your step!

3010118.Content: The priest must stay unharmed-guard him!

3010201.Content: Let him be for now. he's lost in his own thoughts. We'll speak with him once he's calm.

3010202.Content: How exactly are we going to do?

3010301.Content: They've all fallen into a deep sleep, Master. Why?

3010302.Content: Maybe the Void Engram drained their strength. We'll watch over them.

3020101.Content: Hum... so many monsters... so much lightning...

3020102.Content: Narulu, I can't hold out any longer...

3020105.Content: He stood his ground when others fled. We need hearts and talents like his.

3020106.Content: If it weren't for him, Minsterhorn would've fallen before we arrived.

3020107.Content: Corps needs young talent like him... to safeguard the future of Asterleeds and its people.

3020108.Content: Moreover, he witnessed Denvel wield the "Strength." That might be the key to tame these lightning storms...

3020110.Content: Who knows what dangers lie ahead... Stay sharp.

3020301.Content: But damn, Narulu... you actually got struck by lightning and walked it off?!

3020302.Content: You're solid in a crisis! I like that! Once this is over, you should join the Corps-Big Bro Jerrad's got your back!

3020304.Content: (Olvera was right. These currents are highly active. There's something deeper here... I need to scout ahead and uncover the truth.)

3020305.Content: (The body that had collapsed from the earlier tremors across the plains now throbbed with pain once more.)

3020306.Content: (I can sense intense Void Engram from the mark... Perhaps Resonance can dispel it.)

3020310.Content: The Void Engram has completely lost control...

3020311.Content: I don't want to become a monster...

3020313.Content: I beg you, just let me go...

3020401.Content: Only one step remains. If we can achieve Engram Resonance, this chaos will finally be put to rest. All our hopes now rest upon you.

3020402.Content: The Strength flowing through the plants remains unstable. As long as the mark endures, so too will the chaos...

3020403.Content: Mr. Yasser? Ms. Agnes? Are you home?

3020404.Content: It's Narulu's cat. How can this be... Here is its home...

3020405.Content: The house is empty. Little one, can you show us where your humans are?

3020406.ChatName: A diary of an unknown owner
3020406.Content:
[Month X, Day X]
The war ended, but that person never came back. Mom and Dad didn't cry. They just took me out of the city and built this forest of memorial stones.
The Forest Keeper... If one guards the stones for a lifetime, can they see their loved ones' souls after death?

[Month X, Day X]
Sigh... I got caught trying to enlist in the Asterleeds Defense Corps. Mom kept crying... Dad just sighed. "You can't break your mother's heart again, Narulu. She already lost one child. She can't lose another. "
I'm sorry... I just wanted to become strong, strong enough to protect the people I care about.

[Month X, Day X]
No matter what I say, Mom and Dad won't let me join the Corps.
What should I do?

[Month X, Day X]
Today I visited the Pioneer Bureau and saw the adventurers on the leaderboard. They are so strong!
Maybe joining the military isn't the only path for me to become strong...

[Month X, Day X]
This time, Mom and Dad didn't object.
I'm going to become the strongest adventurer. I don't want to lose anyone ever again.

3020407.ChatName: (A key with a small note attached)
3020407.Content:
"To my stupid, forgetful little son,

I have left the door key for you—please take it. This is the last one, so I urge you to keep it safe. Should you lose it again, I'm afraid you will have to spend the night with the cats!"

3020408.Content:
{*me.name*}! I found the cause of the strange weather!
The Engram balance in the plains was suddenly disrupted, throwing the entire ecosystem into chaos.
(To put it in a metaphor: It's like someone flipped over the cooking table, and the sweet pudding turned into deadly spicy food.)
Theoretically, an Engram Core will manifest at the heart of the disaster. Destroying the core should bring an end to the chaos!
Note: The Engram Core will bind itself to the powerful monsters affected by the disaster. If you encounter one, you must tread carefully!
Airona, at the Statue of the Hero

3020501.Content: Hey, Narulu, are you all right? You look exhausted. Don't tell me that lightning scrambled your brain...

3020503.Content:
{*me.name*}:
There's something I should tell you.
Denvel once helped me during my time in the Knights. He guided me forward when I was lost. Without Denvel, I wouldn't be who I am today.
But now, he has become a villain. And I was given the job to take him down. Do I have to choose between gratitude and justice?
"If someone must be sacrificed for him to awaken and atone, then let it be me. " With that resolve, I prepared the Imagine Seed.
Once used, the Imagine Seed will affect both Denvel's mind and power. But I will lose Bio-Engram equal to the power.
If I use it too many times, my life will eventually be drained.
By the time you read this letter, I may already be gone.
I'm sorry for telling you everything this way. I hope my decision can help you all.
Please don't hesitate. Keep moving forward.
Your eternal ally, Tatta

30215001.Content: Adventurer, be careful! Don't startle the Goblin leader.

30215002.Content: See, it's fine. The Adventurer has already passed. Let's follow.

30215005.Content: Muku and Goblins here are fighting even more fiercely.

30215006.Content: Yeah... They're much more savage than before. I really don't know why.

30215007.Content: Isn't it better if they fight? Look, we can use this chance to slip past.

30215009.Content: There seem to be fewer monsters here.

30215010.Content: Don't let your guard down. There are many slopes near the camp. Watch out for ambushes.

30215011.Content: We should reach it by going up this slope. Hang in there!

30216001.Content: Hmm... This spot is good. Looks like a path monsters must take.

30216002.Content: This place is a bit remote, but it can provide early warning against some treacherous monsters.

30216003.Content: This position... Alright, let's give it a try.

30217001.Content: Strange, why is there nothing here?

30217002.Content: Found it, here! Adventurer! Come here!

3030101.Content: <style="emph-gn">{*me.name*}</style>, thank you for being willing to help me.

3030103.Content: I know you've seen it. It belongs to the past. Let it rest.

3030104.Content: Denvel's glory is long gone. Now he's the Knights' disgrace and the indelible stain Byrnhald cannot erase.

3030105.Content: I swore to witness his fall myself, and your belief in me... is all I need.

3030106.Content: More enemies on the other flank. Tatta and me will draw them off. We will leave it to you to slip inside. Good luck, pal!

3030107.Content: It's Denvel... I have but one chance, I cannot afford to squander it...

3030108.Content:
Date: ■■,■■
"I stumbled across it by accident that day. The power Lord Denvel mentioned... it's real. Ever since, I've believed that as long as he's around, the Dark Mist Legion can't be stopped."

Date: ■■,■■
"That creep's been tailing us again. Just like a stray that refuses to be tamed. Honestly, wouldn't it be easier to just get rid of him?"

Date: ■■,■■
"All in. No holding back. Wipe it all out. I'll be the sharpest blade in the fight until Asterleeds falls."

3030109.Content:
Lunch: 300 Luno → Prices in Asterleeds are outrageous! Do I need to skip the dinner?

20 Luno couldn't even get me half a loaf of bread for dinner. In the end, I settled for a glass of water, stomach gnawing with hunger.

After purchasing that potent potion, I was completely broke.

I should've known better than to charter that run-down vessel... If I hadn't, I'd never have crossed paths with that con artist. When is that wretched old cheat going to return my deposit?

Right now, I'm very much close to asking {*me.name*} for a loan. Maybe the Pioneer Bureau has better salary...

But no. I've already burdened others far too many times. One must learn when to stop.

Hmm, I'll endure this. Just a little longer. Once everything is over, I swear I'll return to Byrnhald and treat myself to roast chicken.

3030110.Content: The guards are on high alert. I'll chart a path...

3030111.Content: <style="emph-gn">Circle behind them. Hit the blind spot</style>. I'll regroup with you later.

3030112.Content: Tatta had spent every last coin on this potion, and it was worth every luno-powerful stuff...

3030113.Content: Two sentries are patrolling the perimeter. Wait for the gap... Go-quietly.

3030114.Content: That was close... No more slip-ups

3030115.Content: I've already caused enough tension. I can't afford to make Tina worry again.

3030116.Content: All is clear... Now, we find Denvel.

3030201.Content: The road ahead would only grow more treacherous...

3030203.Content: Another guard up ahead. Take him down quick!

3030204.Content: With this level of security, Denvel has to be nearby! We've come this far, so let's keep our spirits up and press on!

3030205.Content: No targets within range. Please move closer.

3030206.Content: It's you... that pesky little insect from Asterleeds.

3030208.Content: We have knocked them out! Now, for Denvel!

3030209.Content: It was close! Two more targets!

30303001.Content: The animals here all seem uneasy as if they harbor some hatred toward humans.

30303002.Content: I need to find one and talk to it to figure out what's going on.

30311001.Content: Okay, we're clear to investigate. Let's search nearby for the stolen goods.

30311002.Content: (What's this? Uneaten rations? Guess the demi-humans didn't like them.)

30311003.Content: (Looks like a camp water bottle. Goblins turned it into a toy.)

30311004.Content: (That cooking pot's gone too, stolen by goblins.)

30312001.Content: Over here, adventurer! Look at the cliff. See those flowers?

30312002.Content: Check out the Boarriers. Those Crimson Vesicles might be on them.

30312003.Content: Please help me, adventurer. I'm useless in a fight.

30315001.Content: The scouts say the demi-humans are clustered in three locations. Let's go one by one.

30315002.Content: Lots of goblins here... Let's get to work, warriors.

30315003.Content: Plenty of demi-humans too... Your move, adventurer.

30315004.Content: (These ones are tougher than the ones outside... What is that?)

30315005.Content: This is the last spot... We're almost there, adventurer.

30316004.Content:
Dear Ereka,

Greetings to you.
Victoria is a remarkably clever child. No one knows where she came from. I discovered her while delivering documents to the Corps. She was delirious from hunger, so I brought her home. She has stayed with me ever since.
She excels at solving puzzles. She requested I include these details in my letter. While I don't understand their purpose, she insisted they would help you, so I've included them.
She claims she can locate you. While I don't understand how she'll manage this feat, I recognize that even if she finds you, I might not be able to bring you back to the Duchy.
Nevertheless, I maintain hope that she will find you.
The day you were taken to sea, Hugues and I commandeered a fisherman's boat, but Duchy soldiers discovered us shortly after we set sail.
Some claim raiders took you aboard their ship, while others insist you perished.
Though this may now sound like excuses for my helplessness and inaction, Ereka, even without knowing the complete situation, I have always stood ready to be your companion. Or your accomplice.

Perhaps you've forgotten, but before your departure, you scattered nuts across the yard to feed those rarely-seen birds. The remaining seeds took root in the soil and astonishingly developed into beautiful vining plants bearing new fruit.
I've included one of these fruits with this letter.
Should you receive it, it will serve as my eyes.

Hoping to return to your side,
Lloyd

30320002.Content: (Doesn't look any different... Let's find someone to ask where this "Iron Gauntlet" is.)

3040101.Content: With the plains in this state... Should we return to the city and seek Priest Allan's advice?

3040102.Content: Alack... when it comes down to it, these matters don't really concern the Creed. We're better off staying out of it.

3040201.Content: Will this path take us to the Engram?

3040205.Content: Is there a way around it?

3040206.Content: Of course there is! Follow me!

30413001.Content:

30413002.Content: (Hmm, looks like everything's in order. I'll head back to Benedict.)

30420101.Content: I'm by the great tree, near the Caprahorn Carts!

30420102.Content: I'm at the highest point, haha! You'll never find me!

30420103.Content: I'm tucked away in the cargo piles around the great tree!

30420104.Content: Just look up, and you'll spot a white pillar. I'm hiding inside!

30570003.Content: Is anyone here? Excuse me, I was sent by the Asterleeds Defense Corps...

30570004.Content: Huh? There seems to be a note stuck on the door.

30570005.Content: Gone to Minsterhorn for supplies, not at home for now. —The Ramsys

3058.Content: This slot is not yet unlocked

30601001.Content:
My friend, by the time you hear this message,
I'll have already left the surface with the last of our kin.
Too much time has slipped away. I had no other choice...
From now on, our people will sever all contact with the surface. It's likely we'll never meet again.

There have always been differences between our races.
But after meeting you, I came to realize those from other races aren't as unreasonable as they say.
And those of the same race aren't always as trustworthy as they seem.
Forgive my silent departure. I just couldn't bring myself to say goodbye.
The time we shared meant the world to me.
To me, it was a balm that soothed every wound.

To honor our bond, I've left behind something special.

Until you arrive, a Golem will keep it safe.
It's a treasure meant only for you.

This is the last thing I can do before leaving.

Right now, I'm overwhelmed with emotions.
I no longer know what else to say.
All I can do is express myself this way.

Take care, my human friend.

3061201.Content:
When moonlight kisses the tide's high crest, The ocean sighs in silken rest.
Blue silk drapes where lanterns rise, Like stars awakened in the skies-
Fireworks bloomed in the velvet night,
Echoes danced with the tide's delight.

A stranger sways on moonlit sand, With every step, a spell is planned.
Starlight weaves through midnight strands, A crown of stars by fate's own hand.
Her flowing sleeves caress the silver shore, Like whispers lost in ocean lore.
She smiles as fireflies light the air, A fleeting dream, too bright to bear.

Through Flame and Star, the tale takes flight, A dance of dawn, a blaze of night.
They stitch warm dreams in ocean's hue, With threads of gold and skies of blue.
A distant tune begins to start, It softly stirs within my heart:
"Lift the prologue, let fate unfurl, Begin the path that shapes your world."

Waves spun threads of foamy white,
Loosening knots where sky meets tide.

3061301.ChatName: The manuscript scattered by the wind
3061301.Content:
When the wind spirit danced and lifted her dress,
Its wings brushed the dawn in a sky-tinted mess.-
A beam of light cuts through the haze, Unraveling threads of silvered maze.
The Rudder Anemone turns face to sky, To greet the light as it drifts by.

The knight came bearing castle-baked treats,
While Senyu brought jam the villagers keep.
"Your eagle snatched my moonfruit prize!"
He points at the Blade wielder with an empty bowl with teasing eyes.

Ribbons ride the wandering breeze, Gliding soft through fields with ease.
A velvet green rolls far and wide, To meet the glow where dreams abide.
A shutter clicks, the stillness breaks, As roosting birds in silence wake.
Through ruins and peaks the sun descends, Its fiery glow where daylight ends.

Let the sea of clouds drift slow and wide, One final gloaming before they slide-
On these wide plains, among peaks cloud flows, An endless ukiyo-e quietly glows.

Today I attempted to enter the edge of the underground mine. The environment is harsh, just as I expected.
However, there are many medicinal herbs and minerals rarely seen on the surface, and the plants and animals exhibit astonishing adaptability.

I've never seen this kind of Lizard on the surface. My guess is that it must be some type of Magma Lizard, but I'm no animal expert.
I gave it some medicine meant for Caprahorns. It seems pretty friendly—even brought me back some kind of legume.
I think I'll call it "Stokes."


Stokes' injuries are healing incredibly fast. I brought along some medicine that might suit it better, but found its wounds were already almost completely healed.
However, given Lizards don't seem to rely on sight to react to the outside world, I can't verify if its eye is fully healed yet.


...
The growing number of mutated creatures in the highlands is making it more difficult to enter areas with complex terrain. Lizards and Caprahorns affected by the Illusory Bloom are highly aggressive, so even with my tranquilizers and weapons, I still don't dare to approach them.


I saw a massive Lizard with clusters of crystals on its back, clearly affected by the power of Crimson Marrow. This is the first time I've seen a Giant Lizard so severely mutated. It's claimed a massive chunk of land as its territory, and none of the other Lizards seem to dare to approach it.
...
I think it looks familiar.
...
I've decided to come back and check another day.

30656002.Content:
Year 600, Floratiari Month
It has been some time since the main force departed from the Byrnhald Peninsula. I'm gradually getting used to the ship's swaying.
The Duke's encouraging words from the rally still echo in my ears.
We are duty-bound to protect the Duchy's property and suppress the Asterleeds rebels!
Finally, the time has come for me to defeat our enemies on the battlefield and make a name for myself, just like my father.
...
However, I really hope we dock soon. I'd really like some fresh food.

Year 600, Azuraeris Month
Early this morning, deafening shouts rang out across the deck. The second mate had spotted the coastline of the Andra Basin from the crow's nest.
I heard the original plan was to force a landing directly at the Port of Asterleeds, but there's a massive whirlpool right in the middle of the only route there, and bypassing it would take too long.
What's more, the Port is certain to have shored up its fortifications. So, the decision was made to land at Andra Basin instead.
The Dark Mist Legion landed as a vanguard force four months ago, but the situation doesn't seem optimistic.
I'm not sure how that could be, given the giant Golems they deployed.
I can't imagine how human strength could stand against such behemoths.
Thinking about it makes my throat tighten and my stomach churn.

30656003.Content:
Year 600, Lumina Month
We encountered a rebel squad led by a tall man wielding a massive blade near the wreckage of a giant Golem.
They probably anticipated our arrival, so they didn't panic when they saw us, and instead continued to fight as they retreated.
Even though we heavily outnumbered them, they still managed to get away. The Asterleeds rebels are not as weak and incompetent as the Legion Leader claimed.

Year 600, Tidarion Month
Valer fell right in front of me. I could even see the surprise and fear in his eyes.
As for me, my fear was immediately replaced with fury. By the time I came to my senses, the battle was over. I had avenged him.
The funny part of it all is, when the time came to clear the battlefield, I couldn't find Valer anymore. Our people and the rebels were all mixed together.
Valer, we will wipe out all the rebels. It's what they deserve.

30656004.Content:
Year 601, Auriramus Month
The war has lasted for over a year now. I am the only one left alive from my original squad. Valer fell in our first skirmish, while the others still lie in the Kanamia Forest...
I am now the captain of a hundred-man squad. I've moved up the ranks faster than almost anyone in all but frontline units. But I wonder, should I feel happy?
Father, I always thought that small wooden sword was what brought me good luck, but now... it's long since been stained scarlet.
I don't know if this luck will continue.

Year 601, Nivadus Month
Since the battle in Kanamia Forest, my belief in the righteousness of this campaign has wavered. If the rebels truly do as the Duke said,
extorting wealth by oppressing the people, and controlling their freedom through violence,
then why would the artisans of Asterleeds risk their lives so desperately to cover the rebels' retreat?
Father, I once wrote in a letter that I fight for honor and justice.
But what is honor? What is justice?
Father, I am so confused.
But no matter what, I must be responsible for my soldiers. I have to bring them home.

30656005.Content:
(The last page of the diary is covered in dried, blackened water stains. There is only a single passage with no date recorded. The handwriting is messy, seemingly written in a hurry.)
Father, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry...
Mother, please forgive me...
Please forgive me, Mom...

30656006.Content:
Dear Father,
Father, I am writing to you from the Asteria Plains. How is everything at home?
We have already surrounded Kanamia Forest and are preparing to close in ranks.
If the rebel commander isn't completely unskilled in military tactics, they'll try to find a weak point and attempt to break out—but they will find their efforts wasted.
Father, the Asteria Plains are vast and fertile. It's no wonder the Asterleeds rebels harbor treacherous ambitions.
But please rest assured, we will defend Byrnhald's lands to the last. That's what I've come to do!
Father, do you remember when you made me that wooden sword when I was little? I brought it with me. I think of it as a sort of talisman.
...
(Some crossed-out text, seemingly showing hesitation or a careful choice of words.)
Is Mother still mad at me?
She never wanted me to join the army. She was always worried that I'd lose my life before I'd even figured out how I wanted to live it.
But there are always sacrifices in war. I have long since resolved myself to fight for honor and justice!
Father, I won't bring shame to your name.
Please tell Mother not to worry. We will soon suppress the Asterleeds rebels.
Let's share a drink together on the day of my triumphant return.
I might not have the opportunity to write home again after this, so please don't fret over me.
Give my regards to Mother.
Take care.
Love you both.
Leo

30669001.Content:
...That blue-and-yellow striped mutated Arachnocrab blocked the intersection of the mine tunnel like a heavy war chariot.
I had never seen such a brazen monster. It didn't even try to hide when it saw us.
Instead, it paced lazily through the crossroads, as if we were beneath its notice.

We were still whispering about what to do when, in a flash, it charged right in front of us.
Our shields splintered and folded like paper under its pincers.
The rock walls resounded with a massive roar, like the sound of chitinous shells scraping against stone,
or blades clashing against hard iron, so sharp it made my scalp tingle.

Suddenly, someone cried out: It's a mutated Arachnocrab!
Before their words even faded, the miner next to me dropped his pickaxe, only to be tackled by an Arachnocrab bursting from a nearby crevice.

Screams echoed one after another. Our formation faltered completely, and we ran for our lives.
The mine tunnel was littered with severed limbs, and fragments of torn weapons and armor...

30669002.Content:
...It's the fourteenth day, and still no rescue.
Given how long we've been gone, the Legion should long since have sent someone looking for us.
But only darkness lies in this mine tunnel. It's an irregularity that fills me with unease.
I'm even starting to suspect that the last tragedy was an attack targeting the Legion.
Could it be that something also happened... over at the main mine tunnel?

I dare not think too much about it. Right now, the only light we have is the eerie glow of Crimson Marrow.
The vein looks like it's breathing... Ram previously told me not to get too close to that thing—said it would make me lose my mind.
But I am awake. Frighteningly awake. I know I will survive.
Because I discovered that I have the ability to evade Arachnocrab attacks.

Ram didn't—that's why he was dragged away by that Arachnocrab.
A mutated one smashed down from above, its stinger piercing his shoulder armor like a nail through wood.
Before the scream even fully escaped his mouth, he was dragged back into the rocks.
Since then, I understood: if I want to live, I can't think like a human.
I have to think of myself as an Arachnocrab, become part of the Kahn Shaft.
That's the only way to keep the Arachnocrabs from noticing me, and ensure I get to keep living.

I have already avoided several attacks.
But the Kahn Shaft seems to be expanding. More and more branches are appearing.
Our people, on the other hand... are becoming fewer and fewer.

30669003.Content:
...I'm the only one left.
The lamp oil ran out long ago, and I only have one day's worth of rations left.
As I fumbled along by the red glow of the Crimson Marrow, I found words written on the wall,
From Ram: "Turn right after the third branch..."
From Eno: "Stop pretending, I know you took it... Whatever."
From Volken: "Oh no, it's an Arachnocrab! Quick! Pull me up! Pull—"

I know, of course, the messages are carved on the rock walls...
but no matter where I go, they follow me like a shadow.
Even if they used stingers to carve them... it would still take some time. Plus, the moment I look up, the words disappear.

I get it. They're playing a prank on me.
They really are willing to go to any length to get one over on me.
They didn't die. They're just hiding from me, playing hide-and-seek.

The exit is playing hide-and-seek with me too. I can smell the draft...
Yet it hides behind wooden beams and iron nails.
I can clearly hear people talking, yet they hide behind the collapsed rocks.
Someone, please, just answer me.
I really don't have any strength left. I need water.

I don't want to play anymore...

30673004.Content: Whoa, that was quick and clean.

30673005.Content: That's all of them. There were more than I expected.

30673006.Content: Hide, quickly! It doesn't seem to have noticed us yet!

30676001.Content: The sound of a flute is drifting over from the direction of the cliff.

30676002.Content: That sound is so familiar. I feel like I've heard it somewhere before.

30676004.Content: Every place we pass along the way feels so familiar.

30676005.Content: But at the same time, I can't help feeling something has changed.

30677001.Content: After what happened last time, I tried to study that green mushroom I took.

30677002.Content: While passing through a wooded area, the mushroom suddenly shattered, releasing a crimson gas, then turned into powder.

30677003.Content: What's worse, a Mountain Boar in the distance suddenly went berserk and charged straight at me.

30677004.Content: I was deliberately avoiding them, mind you.

30677005.Content: And those Mountain Boars seemed to have completely lost their minds. They weren't just attacking me; they were thrashing about blindly.

30677006.Content: It looks like it's fallen into a deep sleep.

30677007.Content: It shows absolutely no intention of attacking me.

30677008.Content: Adventurer, there are still some Star Spores left here.

30677009.Content: Please use them to heal the Verdant Fang.

30678002.Content: You there, Adventurer! Save me!!! I'll reward you with my finest goods, I swear!

30678004.Content: The footprints lead deep into the abandoned ruins of the mine. The smell of rust here is so strong it's almost overpowering.

30678005.Content: In the corner ahead, several broken wooden crates lie scattered, filled with miscellaneous junk.

30678006.Content: These don't look like anything the miners would've left behind...

30678007.Content: Stuffed inside one crate is an old eyeless ragdoll, along with a recipe book stained with mysterious smudges.

30678008.Content: On the stone pedestal rests an octahedral metal block that looks like an ancient Legacy. Its surface has been meticulously wiped clean.

30678010.Content:
"... Day 14. Those gang fools still think I'm just a crazy old man who likes collecting junk. They have no idea that the depths of the Underground District are connected to the ancient network within these mine ruins...
Today, I finally pieced together an access key to the lower levels of the mine from scrap materials.
Those idiots at Webber Industry actually treated such crucial biomechanical technology as waste! I must find a collaborator with enough 'ambition' to restart this production line..."

30678013.Content: Just as I thought... We'll have to take out those sentries to get in.

30678014.Content: Damn it, we're too late! That old fox has already slipped away!

30678015.Content: The room is in complete disarray, and the air is thick with the pungent smell of engine oil and scorched metal. But no one is here.

30678016.Content:
"...The Muku organism's rejection response is more severe than expected. After limb removal, the neural connection points must be cooled using high-concentration crystal fluid.
...
The first batch of test subjects has been deployed to the plains for live combat data collection. Once equipped with the heavy armor provided by the Legion, these tireless monsters will become the ultimate scavengers..."

30678017.Content:
Lord Benedict:
I have dispatched personnel to arrange the resource channels and shelter you requested. Do not disappoint me.
I need you to establish a secure underground cybernetic production line in the shortest time possible. I want an army of demi-humans with extraordinary combat capability and absolute obedience.
Once I have restored order to the Blackstone Legion, we will rewrite the rules of this continent.
Legion Leader Reiner

30678018.Content: Although Benedict has fled, the origin of the cybernetic demi-humans and the Blackstone Legion's conspiracy have now come to light.

30678019.Content: I need to report the investigation findings to the Pioneer Bureau as soon as possible.

30678020.Content: Whoa... this place is downright as creepy as a sewer.

30678021.Content: These things... why do they look somewhat familiar...?

30678022.Content: (There's a console glowing up ahead. Let's go check it out.)

30678023.Content: Are we really going further? This whole place gives off an incredibly ominous vibe...

30678024.Content: Would you prefer to wait for me here?

30678025.Content: No, no, Adventurer... Hey, wait for me—

30678026.Content: Cages and strange devices... so this is where those monsters were made. How terrifying...

30678027.Content: (Where were all these Crimson Crystals brought in from?)

30679001.Content: All the doors here have been sealed shut for some unknown reason...

30679002.Content: This is... What's dripping from those overgrown branches? A strange liquefaction phenomenon. It's worth documenting.

30679003.Content: Looks like a dead end. Let's try another direction.

30679004.Content: Oh! There's a path here. It might be the right way. Those Golems are blocking us. I'll leave them to you!

30679005.Content: Good heavens... it's like this place has been overrun by those golden branches.

30679006.Content: Adventurer, considering the Golems we just encountered, I have a rather bold hypothesis.

30679007.Content: There were facilities in the ruins used for repairing and modifying Golems. After coming into contact with a Xeno Engram, they underwent a cycle of rejection and adaptation.

30679008.Content: There's only one Xeno Engram I can think of that could cause all this, and that's the Illusory Plague.

30679010.Content: I just hope that's only speculation.

30679011.Content: That's... the tomb's central control unit! Scatter!

30679012.Content: Buy me some time! I have a Legacy that can shut it down. Hold it off!

30679013.Content: Everyone, prepare for battle! Protect the artisan!

30801006.Content: That's enough. Take the river water back to Barry and Hew.

30802001.Content: How magnificent the Bapharian Ruins​ are...

30802002.Content: No Illusory Bloom is detected here, so is she just naturally grumpy?

30802003.Content: Looks like she doesn't need supplies. Head back and report to Belleet.

30802004.Content: Ah! What do you think you're doing?

30803001.Content: Huh?! Don't touch that! That's my pillow!

30803002.Content: Ugh... finally found it! I thought I lost it!

30806003.Content: What a pity that I can't eat the Caprahorn I hunted with so much effort!

30807002.Content: A fox... the fox turned into a human!

30808001.Content: (Why are there... so many Caprahorn horns here?)

30808002.Content: (Maybe I should ask the merchant selling them?)

30809002.Content: (Is there something I'm not seeing behind all this? Or is Demarion the real scammer? I'll have to go ask Travon himself.)

30809003.Content: (Is this... fox fur? Why would a treasure hunter make a special trip to the hunting grounds to hunt foxes?)

30809004.Content: (This clearly isn't something a treasure hunter would have. It has to belong to a merchant...)

30809005.Content: (Could Demarion really be up to something?)

30809006.Content: (An ordinary treasure hunter would never carry this much cargo.)

30810001.Content: (Something's not right... It's too quiet here. There are two groups here. It shouldn't be completely silent...)

30810004.Content: (This is bad. Could they have already started fighting?!)

30811001.Content: (Are these... berries? Covy must have left them, right?)

30811002.Content: (If I follow them, I should be able to catch up to him!)

30811003.Content: (The berries have been crushed. This isn't good...)

30811005.Content: (I've tracked him pretty far now. I must be close!)

30811007.Content: Is anyone there?! Anyone?! Please, somebody help me!

30811008.Content: *Whimper*... Don't... don't let the Mountain Boars find me!

30812001.Content: Adventurer, you can't just leave me hanging if the Creed comes looking for trouble!

30812002.Content: You're the one who dragged me into this mess...

30814001.Content: Why are there so many Mountain Boars here?!

30814002.Content: My Bapharia! They've seen us! Adventurer, save me!

30814003.Content: This is a waterfall, stretching all the way down below the cliff...

30814004.Content: There's absolutely no way you'd see fish jumping here!

30814005.Content: This is the place. Adventurer, can you check if there are any clues?

30814006.Content: (There are traces of a campfire. It seems someone has been here recently...)

30814007.Content: (Some leftover food scraps. Someone has definitely been here...!)

30814008.Content: (How strange... why is the color of the soil here different?)

30814009.Content: (Looks like something is buried here. I'll try digging... Hmm? Slips of paper with drawings on them?)

30815001.Content: There really are a lot of goblins here... Can't let them roam free.

30815004.Content: The battle between adventurers and goblins could make an excellent addition to my thesis...

30816001.Content: Waaah—! How did they chase me all the way here?!

30816002.Content: (It looks like a scholar is being chased by goblins...)

30816004.Content: The goblins nearby shouldn't be so bold after this...

30816005.Content: Let's return to the Pillar of Divinity. We shouldn't make Nida worry.

30816006.Content:
1. Observe the Goblin camp in advance and quickly determine an escape route.

2. Maintain distance from Goblins; if discovered, evacuate immediately.

3. Always carry the shiny minerals Goblins like in your backpack to throw and distract them during an escape.

4. ...

30817001.Content: So exhausting... these goblins are really a nuisance...

30817002.Content: There are other adventurers over there... did something happen?

30821001.Content:
Main Dishes:
Sunraku | "Freestyle Tuna Don"
Freshly cut tuna marinated with soy sauce at low temperature, topped with seaweed flakes and sesame seeds. It looks casual but has an irresistible flavor that makes you keep eating!
Psyger-0 | "Heaven & Hell Carbonara"
The deep aroma of black truffle and the smooth creaminess of white cream meet on a plate of pasta, creating a stunning contrast yet harmonious flavor!
Emul | "Invitation☆Rabituza Special Bread"
A hollowed-out round bread filled with concentrated carrot cream stew, sealing warmth and fullness inside. It's a Rabituza-style dish that you can easily enjoy on the go!

Desserts:
Sunraku | "Max-LUCK Soufflé"
A fluffy and light soufflé with a delicate egg aroma, topped with wafers and popping candy. One bite and it feels like luck is coming your way!
Psyger-0 | "Sweetheart Fruit Pie"
Crispy pie crust filled with fresh fruits and soft cream, with a bright and sweet taste hiding a hidden sentiment...
Emul | "Snow Rabbit White Chocolate Mousse"
Snow-white delicate chocolate mousse, decorated with fresh red strawberries. It looks cute and light, and its sweetness is soft and pure.

Drinks:
Sunraku | "Riot Blood: Max"
The bold fruit scent of pomegranate, the sweet and sour hint of raspberry, and the stimulating taste of coffee overlap in layers, perfect for challengers who seek to push their limits!
Psyger-0 | "Ultimate Day-Night Brew"
The purple and white gradient gently merges, with the smooth texture of taro and yogurt, topped with shining gold powder. It's like a finishing blow crossing the sky!

The refreshing citrus aroma of blue orange and the coolness of slush blend together, adding chewy jelly bits and snowy whipped cream, creating a lively and transforming specialty drink!
