Could they have been left by that underling, Sevian?)

30834004.Content:

30838001.Content: The first placement spot is right here.

30838002.Content: The second water detector is in place. Next, let's head to the very bottom of the mine.

30839003.Content: Please wait, Adventurer! There is a powerful presence ahead!

30843001.Content: There's no sign that the Arachnocrabs' numbers have decreased here... Let's check somewhere else.

30843002.Content: Looks like there's been no change...

30844001.Content: There are quite a few anglers around here. Let's ask them first.

30844002.Content: Both of them mentioned the voice of a mermaid princess... Does she really exist?

30845003.Content: Hah, fools. Did you really think the General's game wouldn't have any risks?

30845005.Content: These footprints look familiar. They're kind of like the Golden Juggernaut's.

30845007.Content:
That's one down.
Judging by the time, General Yageer should have entered the field by now.

30845008.Content: We'd better keep our guard up against that dangerous man.

30845010.Content: Leo! Isn't he a famous adventurer? Why is he lying out here?

30845011.Content: Get out of my way! I only want the fruit of the Tree of Healing. There's no conflict of interest between us.

30845012.Content: Relax. I just want to discuss a partnership...

30845013.Content: According to General Yageer, hunting monster bosses gives an advantage in the game.

30845014.Content: Monster bosses each have their own territory. Just pick any direction.

30850001.Content:
Article One: Identity Verification
Those passing through the checkpoint must state their origin, destination, and reason for stay.
Those who act suspiciously or provide vague answers should not be allowed to pass through the checkpoint easily.

Article Two: Document Verification
Those passing through the checkpoint must provide:
- Cargo Manifest
- Proof of Identity
- Travel Permit
Documents must bear the wax seal of the Asterleeds Council. Otherwise, they will be considered forged.
Those with incomplete documents will be denied entry without exception.

Article Three: Cargo Verification
Verify whether the cargo matches the manifest,
and check for concealed explosives, hazardous materials, or flammables.
Anything capable of disrupting order at the border may be considered contraband.

Article Four: Abnormal Situations
Check wanted posters. If a person seems suspicious or looks similar to someone in the wanted posters,
detain them, then escalate the situation to your superiors. The final decision will rest with your commander.

Appendix: The border situation is complex. Flexibility is permitted in emergency situations.

3910401.Content:
Dear Alida,

By the time you read this, you've probably grown as tall as the third shelf on the bookcase.
I'm sorry I can't be there to count the shooting stars with you outside the window.
Because Dad is guarding a place that's very, very, very beautiful.
Every inch of land here is steeped in starlight and devotion.
There are warmhearted people in the village, and lush green grass...
And there's a tall windmill.
Whenever the weather is clear, the villagers line up in a long, long queue beneath it...
I know lately you've often watched Larry and his family heading out on trips.
And then you get a little cranky with Mom.
But, my dear Alida, please understand. My work is special.
More than anyone, I long to take you across dew-covered meadows,
to hear the mountain wind hum by your ear—
"Has our Alida been good and listened to Mom?"
Alida, I'm making you a promise, right here.
When you're as tall as the windowsill, I'll bring you to Lallipar.
When you see the morning light pour into this beautiful village, you'll understand me.
Then you can sit under the village windmill and read this letter out loud!
So the entire valley can hear it.

Always watching over you,
Dad

40500019.Content: ("New Ideas for Post-Illusory Plague Intervention Based on Shared Dreams"? Such an academic book... with a few notes tucked inside.)

4050002.Content: They chose to rest? To forgive? No... this is impossible! This power... is a curse! It is the mark of eternal judgment upon you!

40500020.Content:
Page 1:
Watching those miners walk through the Crimson Marrow every day,
suffering from the Illusory Plague, I am powerless...
This feeling is unbearable,
just like the helplessness during the Asterleeds Independence War...
It's awful.

Page 2:
Lars and Pal advised me not to overthink,
not to get too emotionally involved.
After all, I just listen to the soldiers' complaints,
then symbolically administer some potions,
make good use of leave, and go explore the nearby plains.
Stay for three or five years, then retire and return to the Duchy—
honored, and able to enjoy life.

Page 3:
The insights from the Kanamia Tribe were eye-opening!
They can actually allow multiple people to enter the same dream to treat psychological trauma.
The Kanamia people have long used this method for trauma treatment.
I suddenly realized—is there a connection between hallucinations and dreams?
I ended my vacation early and returned underground to continue research.
The key lies in adjusting the neural stimulation threshold that induces hallucinations.

If I can find a plant symbiotic with the Illusory Bloom...
perhaps I can achieve this delicate balance.

40500021.Content:
Presented to the Blackstone Legion
Mental Trauma Intervention Unit—
15th Batch of Members.

40500022.Content:
Page 5:
Success!
Research on the Synchrodream Potion made great progress today!
I applied the potion to a miner
and entered his hallucinations...
I saw the warm side of his heart.
His family, his childhood...
I guided these memories, driving away nightmares and the Illusory Plague.
Afterward, he was in tears and spoke so much to me in one breath.
I could clearly feel he was healed; even his eyes shone brighter!
I also saw hope—the Synchrodream Potion seems very promising.

Page 6:
Why?! The Legion has ordered my research to be terminated!
Damn it! Isn't the purpose of the Legion to maintain order in the mines?
The potion clearly works,
yet they not only stopped me from continuing my research,
but they also issued a severe warning!
Why on earth is this happening?!

40500023.Content:
Page 7:
I finally understand,
the rules of survival here...
Outward appearances must match theirs—wild and untamed,
or else one is an outlier, a freak, a criminal.
I can only move my research to the surface.
Fortunately... the Transport Station warehouse is available.

Page 8:
No matter! Since they won't let me treat the miners,
I will treat the villagers of Lallipar instead!
So what if I'm discovered? I only listen to...
the voice of my heart!

Page 9:
Ironically, the Illusory Bloom has already integrated into the highlands ecology. The Blackstone Legion, the embodiment of the Duchy order,
also conducts clandestine operations.
The method that can truly save lives
requires secrecy to carry out.

40503004.ChatName: Flora of Asterleeds: Coastal and Seasonal Plants
40503004.Content:
Entry: Sea Lily
The Sea Lily is a seasonal flower that survives only briefly under specific temporal and environmental conditions.
Its growth cycle closely coincides with the Seabreeze Festival in the coastal areas of Asterleeds. Outside that period, natural cultivation is nearly impossible.

In folklore and historical records, the Sea Lily is often associated with remembrance and cherishing.
These meanings arise not from its use, but from the fleeting nature of its existence and the difficulty of preserving it.
Most people have only a single chance to encounter it within a limited span of time.Thus, it also symbolizes a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.

The Sea Lily demands exacting water and soil conditions.
Barren land, arid climates, or environments unable to provide stable nutrients will cause it to wither rapidly.
Even under suitable conditions, its blooming period is extremely brief—any slight deviation may result in wilting.
Therefore, the appearance of fresh Sea Lilies outside the proper season or beyond coastal regions usually indicates deliberate human intervention,
along with high cost and maintenance risk.

40503005.ChatName: Chapter Excerpt: Two Rumors About Sea Lilies
40503005.Content:
Rumor 1: The Sea Lily and the Noble's Vow
It is said that many years ago, a young noble of distinguished birth in Asterleeds met a girl from Lallipar during a brief stay.
Though not wealthy, she was gentle and sincere. She had a particular fondness for Sea Lilies. To win her smile, the nobleman reserved an entire cart of Sea Lilies and had them delivered to the barren highlands.
But such happiness did not last.
The girl soon passed away from illness, and their romance came to an end.
Some say the nobleman never married thereafter.
He vowed that even after her passing, her beloved Sea Lilies would bloom each year in the place she once called home.
Thus, every Seabreeze Festival, he ordered Sea Lilies again—an offering to a time that could never return.
Whether truth or fiction, none can say. Only the fragrance returns, year after year.
Rumor 2: The Sea Lily and the Unlucky Flower Peddler
Another account bears no trace of romance.
Rumor claims a flower trafficker once fled to Lallipar with a shipment of Sea Lilies of dubious origin, hoping to evade inspection in the city.
He failed to escape the villagers' notice.
Reports were filed, witnesses stepped forward, and before long the Asterleeds Defense Corps followed the trail and arrested him on the spot.
The Sea Lilies were seized as evidence, never to be seen again.
As for whether anyone has since dared to smuggle flowers onto the plateau...
Ahem. That, this author cannot say.

40503006.ChatName: Legend of Airona - Deluxe Special Edition
40503006.Content:
Prologue: The Lone Star Kissed by Fate
The adventurer Airona—now a legend. Ah, to write the first line of her origins, the pen should bow to the sun and borrow a sliver of silver from the moon!
In the years before she had a name or a home, she was but a faint sigh in the wind and snow—a wandering orphan. Wrapped in tattered yet stubborn hems, like a note the world had forgotten, she fell upon the loneliest edge of the wilderness.
Yet the wilderness did not refuse her.
Wild wolves schooled her in vigilance through their silence; Caprahorns tempered her courage with their defiance. Thus she grew up—between mountain streams and frost-laden mist, and within the cave behind the waterfall.
Upon its walls were carved the secrets of the Bapharian Relic. When her hand touched that legacy, heaven and earth seemed to hold their breath!
Light slipped through her fingers, as though fastening an invisible ribbon to her future. From that moment on, her gaze shone like a distant star—clear, unyielding, edged with a brilliance even the sun dared not confront.
Thus began her journey.
From the surf and lantern-lit shores of Asterleeds to the windswept earth of the Bahamar Highlands, to the echoes of the valleys and the war songs of the Duchy. Wherever she went, the mighty lowered their heads, the timid fell silent, and even the proudest blades learned humility in her presence.
She challenged masters far and wide, and knew no defeat—like twilight clutching the last unextinguished ray of light.
Yet legend is not forged by sword and steel alone.
In every city she passed through, someone lay awake for her in the dark. In every place she lingered, someone quietly penned longing in their heart.
Poets wrote her name into rhymes. Painters traced her smile. And nameless travelers, having glimpsed her from afar, found themselves forever unable to face the moonlight with a steady heart.
They dared not speak of love, yet would not deny it. They spoke of admiration, of respect, of fate's injustice—only to end each sentence with a hidden sigh, like a drop of rain that never fell.
And she?
She merely smiled."Vows of love are like sand—the wind scatters them, and looking back is a waste of time."

40503007.Content:
Entry: Airona
In the war to seal the witch Hruga, the adventurer Airona played a pivotal role in multiple battles, significantly influencing the course of the conflict.
It was during this period that her name first appeared in official battle reports from various factions and quickly became known across the land.
Shortly after the war, Airona was widely regarded as one of the youngest prodigy adventurers in Regnus.
Her combat judgment, adaptability, and execution consistently demonstrated a level of maturity beyond that expected from ordinary experience, as recorded in numerous mission reports.
In stark contrast to her achievements is the scarcity of personal information about her.
Despite repeated attempts by many to conduct exclusive interviews, Airona almost never consented to in-depth questioning, offering only brief responses when necessary.
She is known to be gentle and courteous, maintaining good relations with colleagues, yet she keeps her own past tightly guarded.
Currently, Airona resides in Asterleeds and continues her activities in the Pioneer Bureau as an adventurer.
Official records provide no clear details of her origins or upbringing.
Perhaps it is precisely because this adventurer's past remains shrouded in mystery
that she truly merits the title of "Legend."

40503008.Content: It's about time—let's go over the clues!

40503009.Content:
Records indicate that, many years ago, Lallipar Village suffered a severe famine.
The soil was barren, crops withered, and population outflow increased. The settlement was once listed as nearly abandoned.
Cross-referenced scattered rumors suggest that a local herbalist, Ms. ██,
provided a batch of seeds—previously unseen in the area—during the peak of the disaster.
These seeds thrived on the highlands and gradually restored the village's vitality.
The origin of the seeds is deliberately omitted in existing records.
What is known is that when distributing the seeds, Ms. ██ made a single request to the villagers:
This matter must remain secret. No one may inquire about the seeds' origin or discuss the events outside the village.
Regrettably, Ms. ██ passed away shortly after due to old age.
With the key figure gone, the event was never publicly revisited and does not appear in subsequent official documents.
Current villagers have varying awareness of this history; most seem unaware of the details.
Record ends here.

40503010.Content:
This is an old herbal book. The page corners are worn, and the paper has yellowed with age.
In addition to standard entries and transcriptions, the book contains handwriting from different periods.
One particularly youthful record appears to have been read over repeatedly:
"Today I organized the medicine cabinet with Grandma. She said these books have been passed down through the family.
I can't remember them yet, but she said it doesn't matter—one day I will."
Flipping further, the handwriting grows more mature, and the records evolve from simple copying to personal insights and explanatory notes.
In the blank spaces of the pages, years that were marked and then faded out can occasionally be seen, though only faint traces are left.

40503011.Content:
Month X Year X
Today, my granddaughter was born. I named her Belleet.
The house suddenly filled with life, and I found myself laughing for the first time in a long while.
Watching Marlene hold her, I felt that all my hardships over the years finally had meaning.
Month X Year X
Belleet can already toddle about, always trailing behind me.
I teach her the herbs in the medicine cabinet, but she prefers listening to stories.
My granddaughter grows day by day, yet Marlene's health worsens.
I prepare medicine and brew soups for Marlene, but they only ease her suffering a little.
Some things, after all, cannot be cured with herbs.
Month X Year X
Marlene is gone. Though I am a herbalist, I could not save my own daughter.
Since that day, I told myself that no matter what, I must raise Belleet well.
Yet since then, I have begun to tire more easily.
My hands tremble, and I wake earlier each morning.
Perhaps it will not be long before I must slowly entrust many things to her.
Month X Year X
The land no longer responds to our efforts. There is less food every day.
As a herbalist, there is little I can do.
If the Bapharian Divines truly exist, why will they not help us?
Month X Year X
...I rescued a most extraordinary guest.
She looked exhausted, yet her gaze remained gentle.
She was beautiful, yet she seemed as though she did not belong here.
Month X Year X
It was only for one short night. But we talked a lot.
About journeys, about the wind, about what people leave behind.
It would be wonderful if I could see her again.
But I fear my time is running short.
Month X Year X
She left.
Month X Year X
Everything seems to be getting better.
The crops are growing again, and the children are laughing once more.
I didn't mention that night to anyone.
Some things are best left buried in the soil.

50070001.Content:
The wise never fall for traps, for traps are always dressed in the sweetest guise.
When the flowers are in full bloom, their fragrance fills the air. Indulge in it, and you will fall into a web of sweet dreams, losing the courage to ever awaken.
The stone bridge leads to the path of wakefulness. Come, everything you desire may be right here...

50070002.Content:
Surprises may await where the cries of beasts are heard. Skilled hunters draw their bows while their eyes remain fixed on their prey.
When you hear the whistle of an arrow, the cry of a fox resounds by the lake in the hunting grounds...

50070003.Content:
Life itself is a stroke of luck, and luck is bound to lead to treasure.
Ice crystals often form where water flows swiftly. When spring arrives, the ice thaws, and life awakens with it...
Thus, the joys of fishing can be found here...

50070004.Content:
The pool is lit up at night, startling people from dreamland. If you are lost in an illusory dream, then listen closely—
Why do you awaken? The unending thunder is why...

50070005.Content:
Secrets are often hidden in places known to none. Humans have always been fond of hiding treasure in caves...
A hidden hollow on the side of a cliff is the best spot to escape prying eyes, and the sea breeze that slips through the cracks carries away slumbering sorrows.

50070006.Content:
Crimson Marrow entices travelers to linger here, while the nearby pool witnesses the extent of their avarice.
When the greedy, fallen into illusion, are buried by the ore, only the cold, pure water can awaken them from their dreams.

50070007.Content:
High and unreachable spots make the best hiding spots.
Where the wind howls, on the northernmost cliff, there is a secret untouched by any soul.
Be careful, and do not look down... for while the wind can carry you, it can also cast you down.

50070008.Content:
The sound of a working crane carries its own rhythm, but the abandoned ruins can no longer make a sound.
In the flower-strewn forest, an old musical score lies forgotten. Embark on a search to discover if a beautiful song still lingers in that forsaken place.

50070009.Content:
Illusory flowers bloom, their mist lingering in the wild.

The Distant Flower gazes at the Heavenly Pillar;
The Hanging Flower hides its roots beneath the valley;
The Spirit of Delusion lurks in the shadows, gnawing on the prey of the Everdark Flower.

Use the flowers as pins to connect the veins and establish a map.
It slumbers in the deepest pool at the very center, like a traveler delving into a desolate dream.

50090010.Content:
In the 602nd year of the Alician calendar, restrictive measures were imposed upon Tina.

Following the restoration of the Hruga Seal, Tina's continued existence became a subject of grave concern across the Continent of Magna.
Many councilors believed that, for the sake of continental safety, strict protective measures were necessary-measures that would, in effect, strip Tina of her personal freedom entirely.
Fearing that excessive restrictions might provoke unintended consequences, a compromise was ultimately reached, resulting in Tina's confinement to the Asteria Plains under the direct supervision of Defense Corps Commander Olvera.

Note: Though Olvera and Tina were once close, the Kanamia Forest Skirmish had driven a wedge between them. This strained relationship requires close monitoring for potential operational complications. Should any unforeseen incidents arise, the reinstatement of full containment protocols would need to be reconsidered.

50090011.Content: Lady Airona, long time no see.

50090013.Content:
In the 608th year of the Alician calendar, the Council once again turned its attention to the question of Tina-her identity, her power, and the role she ought to play in Asterleeds' future. In the wake of recent unrest,

her repeated acts of valor and unwavering defense of Asterleeds had not gone unnoticed.
A growing consensus emerged within the Council, advocating for her formal recognition as an asset rather than a liability. In response to these discussions, a proposal was introduced to officially acknowledge Tina's contributions and confer upon her the Hero Medal. Despite Commander Olvera's firm opposition-cautioning that thrusting Tina back into the public eye would only heighten the danger surrounding her-the proposal was approved.
However, the risks inherent in Tina's sensitive nature remain undeniable. Continued vigilance in both her protection and supervision is imperative.

50103001.Content:
When Aislinn was with me, she didn't expect me to become famous or get rich. She never cared about any of that.
It was me. I was vain. I was impatient... so desperate to give her a home that I told those lies.
What do I do now...? What happens next? If I never make it big—what becomes of all those lies?
Aislinn, I shouldn't have... I shouldn't have deceived you...

50103002.Content:
I never should have left. Or I should have gone back the moment I realized I'd achieved nothing.
I should have confessed my failure... gone back to Aislinn, and started over—together.
It wouldn't have mattered if things were slower, or harder... as long as Aislinn was by my side.
We used to imagine a future with just a small place of our own, maybe a little tight on money...
All that mattered was the two of us holding onto that simple, cozy little home...
But now she knows my success was a lie. If I go back... won't she be disappointed?
I'm not afraid of her blaming me, or shouting at me... I'm afraid of disappointing her...

50103003.Content:
I can't keep lying anymore! Aislinn deserves to know the truth!
She deserves to know that I deceived her for three years—made her wait all that time, only to end up a failure...
Whether she accepts it or not, I have to apologize...
I wanted to tell her face-to-face. No matter the outcome—whether she's angry enough to curse me or so hurt that she can never forgive me—I have to face it.
We never should have had those three empty years between us, and she shouldn't have been kept waiting because of my lies.
I may be a terrible, utterly unworthy partner... but my feelings for her were never false.

5018000.Content:
Main Dishes:
Koyomi Araragi | "Undying Red Wine Beef Stew"
Tender beef enveloped in a rich, dark wine sauce. Its deep crimson hue resembles a fresh bloodstain that refuses to dry under the moonlight... A heavy flavor with a dangerously haunting aftertaste.

Hitagi Senjyogahara | "Cloud-Light Omurice"
Soft and fluffy as a cloud at first glance, but cutting it open reveals a surprisingly filling tomato rice interior. A dish defined by the unexpected contrast between its lightness and its weight.


Desserts:
Koyomi Araragi | "Not-So-Ordinary Donut"
At a glance, it seems like nothing more than an ordinary donut. Yet its layers of sweetness and toasted aroma build upon each other, like a subtle fracture in the mundane, a glimpse of the extraordinary.

Hitagi Senjyogahara | "100% Sensational Mille-Feuille"
Each crisp layer is perfectly defined, delivering a bold, straightforward sweetness. Elegant and sharply refined, this dessert demands your full attention with its overwhelming presence.


Drinks:
Koyomi Araragi | "Spring Break Echo: Blood Orange Fizz"
Blood orange and berries interweave into a bittersweet tang with a hint of danger. It carries an unsettling atmosphere that lingers long after a certain spring break has ended…

Hitagi Senjyogahara | "Dual‑Tone: Elegant & Sharp"
A blue-purple gradient, quiet and beautiful. It meets the palate with a sharp, acidic sting followed by sweetness, finally trailing off into a mellow aftertaste—a cocktail as biting as it is elegant.

50260001.Content:
Issue No. [01]

It happened just last night. Yes, that very night filled with salty sea breezes and boundless youthful energy.
Along the shoreline of Silvergull Beach, rumor has it—and please note, the author is deliberately employing a highly irresponsible hearsay tone here—that multiple eyewitnesses claim to have glimpsed a legendary creature.

White.
Colossal.
Something with wings that burst forth from the waves.
Its gliding path across the moonlit sea looked exactly like a reenactment of the island's ancient romantic legend.
In other words—it was the dreamlike creature that exists only in fairy tale picture books and the folklore passed down by elders, symbolizing miracles and summer encounters: the Winged Whale.

So, what was the outcome?

Just open your window, and you'll see tourists everywhere holding paintbrushes, attempting to capture the lingering image of the island's legend. Some have even spontaneously formed the so-called Winged Whale Investigation Team—evoking a thrilling sense of déjà vu, like a secret society determined to observe an unknowable star or capture an impossible future. Are they prepared to stay awake through the night, kissing the salty sea breeze, just to witness a miracle?
The blindness and impulsiveness of youth are truly dazzling—and helplessly consumable.

And so, the question arises.
Beneath the shimmering, seemingly tranquil surface of the sea surrounding Asteria, what kind of heart-pounding secrets lie hidden?
Whether it is true or false hardly matters.
A so-called legend is, after all, a puzzle pieced together from countless coincidences, illusions, and well-intentioned yearnings. This newspaper—or rather, the author of this piece—will uphold a spectator's inquisitive spirit and continue to track frontline intel from this summer carnival for you.

After all, before the truth is fully revealed, or before the legend finally descends—
doesn't everyone have the right, this summer, to have their gaze stolen by that shining white silhouette, and to indulge—quite justifiably—in a daydream called miracle?

Written by Sleepless Fog

50261001.Content:
Issue No. [02]

"I saw it."
A statement brimming with subjectivity and uncertainty.
When we utter these words, is it because we've truly seen something, or is it merely an attempt to satisfy a deep-seated desire for attention?

Last night, rumors about the silhouette of a giant whale spread across Starland like a tidal wave. There are no small number of people who claimed to have seen the outline. One individual stands out from the crowd of fanatics dizzied by the sea breeze.
I'll conceal her name for now. In the face of a massive island legend, after all, an individual's name is simply a meaningless moniker. Let's call her Miss Eyewitness for now.

Regrettably, I was unable to verify her claims personally.
This Miss Eyewitness seems to be deliberately avoiding something, like a ghost desperate to escape the spotlight, hiding herself in the shadows of the crowd. In recent days, true believers seeking out the Winged Whale have been searching for this girl high and low, like so many ants that have caught a whiff of sugar. And who can blame them—a self-proclaimed eyewitness to a miracle is harder to find than a needle in a haystack.

As for me, I've only managed to put together a rough sketch of her from hushed conversations heard in passing on the streets. Even getting that far has been as difficult as piecing together a shattered mirror.
Rumors have it, she's a girl with short golden hair, restrained in part by a hairband, that sways in the night breeze, with a blue skirt that almost blends in with the deep blue of the ocean.

This girl, surrounded by rumor and shrouded in mystery, is the one who announced the arrival of the giant white beast.
The most baffling part of the whole story—and perhaps the most cunning—is that she refuses to disclose exactly which of Starland's waters the Winged Whale descended upon.

Is she truly describing a miracle, or was it just the illusion we call "summer" reflected in her eyes?
The truth of the matter remains slumbering beneath the waves. As for us at this paper, you can rest assured that we will continue to glean what we can from the bubbles that rise to the surface.

Written by Sleepless Fog

50262002.Content:
Issue No. [03]

Word has it that the number of tourists setting foot in sea-breeze-swept Starland has today crossed a historic threshold, shattering every one of the stuffy records from its boring past. Humans truly are creatures easily dominated by blind conformity.

And in this vortex of frenzy triggered by the Winged Whale, those profiteers who call themselves the Meowlux Merchant Guild are ruthlessly plundering the deflated wallets of sightseers. All sorts of Winged Whale-themed merchandise bearing giant wings and round bodies—especially plushies—are now being snatched up at stalls everywhere, faster than even the island's rolling waves. No matter how bizarre a trinket looks, as long as it bears some semblance to the legendary aquatic creature, it flies off the shelves. Truly a breathtaking spectacle of consumption.

However, beyond the crisp clinking of coins and the clamor of the crowd, the seemingly forgiving sea appears to be growing impatient with human dullness as well.
According to investigations by the Asterleeds Defense Corps, an unsettling restlessness is quietly brewing in the waters surrounding Starland. Here, I must issue a rare warning, even if it might not be in keeping with the times: Travelers, I know you're absolutely spinning with the fun of all this, but don't let the tides of ecstasy draw you out into those deep waters. After all, being swallowed by a turbulent sea is not covered under Meowlux's refund policy.

Written by Sleepless Fog

50263002.Content:
Issue No. [04]

Absence.
It's a fascinating state of existence.
While its white wings have driven the world into a fever pitch, the legend itself has chosen, in an incredible display of arrogance, absence.
No stunning flights, slicing through the firmament; no giant waves capsizing boats. The dreamlike creature we've bestowed with the title Winged Whale has not spared a single scale for the shores full of eager eyes.

However, human desire absolutely forbids the existence of a vacuum.
With the ocean's surface devoid of anything interesting, people are naturally casting their greedy gazes toward deeper, darker places.

For instance, those transparent, perfectly refractive objects settled right beneath the currents.
According to reliable sources, mysterious crystals with extraordinarily high light transmittance were recently discovered beneath the seabed right off the coast of Starland. The Meowlux Merchant Guild, always the first to smell new opportunities, has evidently deemed these transparent stones—worthless other than for their aesthetic value—as the next brilliant business opportunity to fill the Guild's coffers.

On another note:
The Summer Sea Fishing Grand Prix—exclusively sponsored by the Meowlux Merchant Guild—will officially kick off tomorrow.
A fishing tournament held at this moment, so steeped in legends and the promise of riches, is bound to end up as a carnival of absurdity.
Could it be that some decision-maker within the Guild, or some frenzied tourist whose sense of reason has been blown off by the sea breeze, is actually naive enough to believe they can drag that legendary giant sea beast from the depths of the ocean to the sandy beach with nothing but a fishing line and a hook?

If so—well, I truly look forward to seeing the farce they'll call a miracle.

Written by Sleepless Fog

50264005.Content:
Issue No. [05]

I've got news, everyone: the summer frenzy officially reaches its peak today!
The Summer Sea Fishing Grand Prix—sponsored solely by the Meowlux Merchant Guild—has officially dropped its bait at Silvergull Beach.
However, an ordinary fish will obviously not be enough to satiate today's Starland.
The organizers have announced that, aside from the standard weight and rarity evaluations, they've added an extra special prize to the competition this year, one guaranteed to drive participants wild—

the Winged Whale Prize.

That's right.
If any participant truly manages to reel the legendary Winged Whale onto the shore today, they will receive a cash prize large enough to make any adventurer rethink their life choices!
Notably, the organizers offered no guidance as to how one might be expected to pull a giant sea beast to the beach with nothing more than a fishing rod.
Regardless, Silvergull Beach is already packed with people, undoubtedly all lost in the same daydream.

So, what exactly will take the bait today?
Let's find out together.

Written by Sleepless Fog

5206001.Content:
Denvel once told me that a Dominion duty is to achieve peace with the least possible sacrifice. But that philosophy... it doesn't suit this war.
The weight of his soldiers' deaths nearly crushed him. He clings to old memories just to escape the pain. Perhaps those memories were too vivid-they gave rise to an Imagine Seed.
Yet war has changed him. Denvel no longer seeks peace. Now, he craves victory. He's cast aside the man he once was... and become the nightmare of his enemies. Honestly, he frightens me more than the enemy ever could.
I hoped the Imagine seed would remind him of who he was-free him from his rage, and whatever darkness grips him. But... he rejected my offer. Has he truly decided to sacrifice himself for victory?
Still, I carry the seed with me. I fear what might happen if he continues down this path. I will stop him. I must.

-Jayden,
August, the 600th year of the Alician calendar

[Minsterhorn Village Bulletin]
A must-read for anyone entering the village:
1. All outsiders coming for business or a tour must follow the village's trade rules. Do not disturb village life.
2. The wheat fields are of great importance to the village. Anyone caught picking or polluting them will be permanently banned from entering the village.
3. Lastly, we welcome all friendly travelers to experience the culture and charm of Minsterhorn!
Chief Javier
...
[Brief History of Minsterhorn Village]
The Minsterhorn you see today is not the original location. The former village was destroyed in the war, but the survivors were temporarily sheltered by the main city of Asterleeds, and the village was able to continue.
After the war, the survivors, led by Chief Javier, rebuilt the current Minsterhorn Village here.

60070002.Content:
[Andra Resting Post]
Built beside the historic Andra Basin battlefield, this resting post was initially built by scavengers around the Andra Landing Battlefield after the war.
Later, due to malicious competition and resource snatching among the scavengers, it was taken over by two sisters: Cove and Liv.
There are many versions of how exactly they managed it. All that's known is, after that, the scavengers became wary of the two sisters, and the elder sister, Cove, became the resting post's overseer.
Eventually, it evolved into a resting place that provides lodging and meals for traveling merchants.
...
[Survival Rules of the Andra Resting Post]
1. If you see Cove frowning, leave the resting post immediately.
2. There are no cats in the resting post. If you see one, leave at once and inform Liv.
3. Do not easily trust anyone, especially those who smile.
4. Never scavenge the Andra ruins at night.
5. Whatever someone gives you, you must return something of equal value.

60070003.Content:
The chosen site for Kanamia originally featured a solitary boulder within a natural spring.
Upon arrival, the site selection scholars reported experiencing profound tranquility and spiritual clarity. This phenomenon was brought to the attention of Chief Rotroani.
Following approval, master stonemasons of Kanamia were commissioned to construct a commemorative statue titled "Ancestors and Their People," symbolizing the enduring protection of the ancestors over the people of Kanamia.
Subsequent investigations revealed that the spring's soothing effects stem from its subterranean connection to the sacred groundwater of the Forbidden Zone.
This water is believed to be imbued with the spiritual essence of the Ancestral Relic.
To the Kanamians, this was the protective force of their ancestors watching over them.

60070004.Content:
In Kanamian tradition, residents construct stone towers-known as "requiem towers"-by stacking stones in memory of deceased clan members.
According to legend, the taller the tower, the quicker the soul's journey to reunite with the ancestors.

Due to access restrictions around the Forbidden Zone, the Zeroing Spring has become the primary site for mourning, making wishes, and brooding over memories.

It is widely regarded as the second holiest location in Kanamia.

Locals often inscribe the names of lost loved ones on stones and cast them into the spring or construct requiem towers nearby.

Perhaps the prayers offered here may guide the beloved departed-those loved and lost-safely into the embrace of their ancestors, sparing their souls from an eternity of lonely wandering in this world...

60070005.Content:
A tree species unique to the Kanamia region. It has existed for centuries, even before the new Kanamia settlement was built.
Nourished by underground water influenced by ancestral relics, these trees continue to grow until the very moment of their decline. Even now, as Kanamia has built treehouses around them, the immortal trees keep growing taller and larger.

There's a saying passed down in Kanamia: the immortal trees can form a spiritual bond with certain special individuals.
Once in resonance, one can "communicate" with the tree and even guide its growth.
But no one has ever succeeded. It remains only a legend.

60070006.Content:
1. Every member of the community must hold no belief that contradicts the teachings of the ancestors, honoring their wisdom above all.
2. The will of the ancestors must be upheld with the utmost respect. Every member of the community is bound to honor their sacred directives.
3. All living beings and the natural world must be treated with compassion and care. Cruelty towards them is strictly prohibited.
4. A filial duty to one's parents is paramount. Abandonment or disrespect towards them is forbidden.
5. Every member must not harm the lives or possessions of others.
6. Falsehoods, including slander and deceit, are forbidden.
7. The seizing of others' property or persons is prohibited.

60070007.Content:
A hundred years ago, the ancestors of the Kanamian were still scattered across the plains in small tribes, living off basic hunting and gathering.
Later, under the leadership of Rotroani's grandfather, Kanamia was unified. All the small tribes gathered together and gradually formed what is now the Kanamia Tribe.
The former practices of communal living, hunting, and gathering were preserved and evolved into today's extended-family model, hunting competitions, and a hybrid system of foraging and cultivation.
Over time, Kanamia also developed animal husbandry, aquaculture, infrastructure, and manufacturing techniques. People's daily lives became more structured, and the tribe's systems more complete.
Throughout this development, one thing has never changed: the Kanamia people's reverence for their ancestors.
To outsiders, this might seem like ignorance, but for the Kanamian, it is an unshakable foundation.
It is the ancestors who constantly remind every Kanamian that, no matter how history moves forward, one must always preserve sincerity, kindness, and a sense of awe toward the continent, nature, and the world.

60070008.Content:
The dwelling shared by Rorola and Rotroani, constructed in accordance with the traditional Kanamian practice of communal living. It also serves as a resting place for the village elders.
Within it remain numerous belongings from Rorola's early childhood, yet there is a conspicuous absence of personal artifacts from her adolescence or present life. She and her father used to leave notes for each other, but six years ago, their exchanges seemed to have stopped.
It's as if time in this treehouse has been frozen in the past.

60070009.Content:
At present, the treehouse bears numerous signs of recent activity.
Rorola and Rotroani have resumed their habit of exchanging daily notes-brief reminders concerning tribal matters or simple essentials like food, clothing, and shelter.
Beside Rorola's bed lies a growing collection of small treasures she has gathered-delicate flowers, beautiful stones, and other keepsakes.
Though I haven't witnessed their life here firsthand, traces of their presence are woven into every corner of the treehouse.

60080005.ChatName: Conspiracy Behind the Peace Treaty, authored by Smith
60080005.Content:
An Alternative Perspective on the Peace Treaty

In Year 602, Alician calendar, Byrnhald and Asterleeds signed the Peace Treaty.
From then on, Asterleeds gained its freedom.

But... are we truly free?
How many people have actually read the "Peace Treaty" carefully?
Here are a few clauses:
"From the date of signing this treaty, Asterleeds and Byrnhald shall maintain trade. Tax adjustments shall be made on a 6-month cycle, with changes not exceeding 0.5% per period. "
"From the date of signing this treaty, Asterleeds Defense Corps must lose at least 65% of its wartime establishment and shall not expand its establishment without authorization. "
"From the date of signing this treaty, Byrnhalds shall retain free access to Asterleeds. Asterleeds shall not refuse for any reason. "
...
Can you sense the arrogance hidden within these clauses?

Asterleeds has always regarded itself as the victor.
But when the treaty was signed, it did not hold a position of advantage.

Let's summarize:
First, according to reports from the various military squads, Byrnhald's main forces were largely intact at the time of the agreement.
Second, the war ended amidst the mysterious "Revelation" event, and Byrnhald never formally surrendered.
Lastly, the treaty contains no clauses clearly favoring the interests of Asterleeds.

Based on this solid evidence, we can make a bold conjecture:
The "Peace Treaty" is actually just a whitewash for a compromise.

Now let's analyze the post-war economy and politics:

Asterleeds' prosperity has long flowed with the tides of trade,
its strong shipbuilding tradition and Seaside advantage
ensuring its success in maritime commerce.

-The Primordial Engine,
retrofitted by Artisan Johnson,
became the first Legacy ever adapted as a ship engine,
Pioneering the integration of Legacy-powered propulsion with marine vessels.
Its successful use in propelling a small fishing boat
marked the dawn of Asterleeds' legendary maritime fishing era.

-The Second-Generation Engine,
designed by Chief Artisan Benedict and
retrofitted through the collaboration of elite craftsmen,
led to the discovery of an alternative Legacy known as the "Engram​ Engine."
With abundant Legacy reserves enabling mass production,
this technological advancement allowed Asterleeds to
dominate fisheries through naval superiority, ultimately laying the foundation for its maritime trade supremacy.

-The Third-Generation Engine,
enhanced by Chief Artisan Ted using the "Engram Engine" as its foundation,
unlocked the Legacy's full potential through precision modifications. With its increased output
enabling the propulsion of giant oceanic cargo vessels,

this breakthrough catalyzed a new epoch in Asterleeds' maritime shipping industry.

with critics accusing it of being nothing more than a publicity stunt, overly dramatized for effect.
...
Yet, without question, whenever Asterleeds is mentioned, the word "freedom" is never far behind.
Whether mocked or admired, the open Council Hall has become synonymous with the city itself.
In this regard, the symbolism is the most important.
It represents Asterleeds' unwavering commitment to the ideals of liberty.

60080011.Content:
In summary,
long-standing dissatisfaction had been brewing within Asterleeds regarding the policies imposed by Byrnhald.
The eventual uprising was merely a matter of time.

In the 600th year of the Alician calendar, tensions escalated dramatically when Byrnhald imposed an excessively burdensome tax increase.
This policy resulted in a severe inflation of commodity prices in Asterleeds-
so extreme that a single piece of cake cost approximately 200 Luno, equivalent to the wages of a laborer over ten days.
This economic pressure served as the immediate catalyst for the Asterleeds Independence War.

-The Andra Basin Skirmish- The First Spark That Shattered Chains
Following the outbreak of Asterleeds Independence War,
Byrnhald deployed its vanguard forces-including the Dark Mist Legion-via maritime entry into the Andra Basin.
There, they encountered the Asterleeds Defense Corps soldiers led by Commander Olvera. A significant engagement ensued, now referred to as the Defense Battle of Andra Basin.
During this operation, Olvera and a rising figure, Tina, cooperated strategically to repel the invading force.
After the war, Tina was requested by Olvera to become her aide-de-camp.

60080012.Content:
When war truly breaks out, ideals alone can't solve everything.
Against a nation like Byrnhald, Asterleeds was severely disadvantaged.
At the start of the war, Asterleeds' equipment was very outdated,
while Byrnhald's technology was far more advanced.
Once the fighting began, the Asterleeds Defense Corps were mocked by Byrnhald for their outdated gear.


So how did Asterleeds turn the tables around? Where was its path forward?
This brings us to Asterleeds' legendary figures-Olvera and Tina.
During the Asterleeds Independence War, Olvera served as the commander of the Defense Corps, with Tina as her deputy.
The forces they led could always turn the tide under dire circumstances and win against the odds.
- The early ambush on the plains on 601
- Kanamia Forest Skirmish
...
More importantly, their feats quickly spread among the Defense Corps. Wherever they went, they never lost.
This also became a sort of psychological warfare for the under-equipped and outnumbered Defense Corps: if you can't win with numbers or gear, then win with morale.

Additionally, some councilors and artisans had long anticipated a war with Byrnhald.
They secretly invested heavily in the Artisan Guild to develop prototype equipment.
Thanks to the inspiration of figures like Olvera and Tina,
along with many other factors, the gap between Asterleeds and Byrnhald slowly closed.

60080013.Content:
Back then, living conditions were harsh, and there weren't so many Legacies that had been excavated.
Legacies related to housing, furniture, and home improvement were especially scarce.
According to some elders, Asterleeds at that time could barely be called a city; it was more like a town in scale.
As the population grew rapidly, issues like housing shortages, insufficient basic goods, and poor infrastructure emerged.
The then-government—what would later become the Council—issued public calls for construction artisans, but very few responded.

Under such circumstances, a group of artisans stepped forward, willing to put aside their valuable Legacy research and
devote themselves to the hard work of designing housing, restoring city infrastructure, and crafting furniture.

You must understand: engaging with and researching Legacies is what motivates many to become artisans. It's their dream.
These artisans knew full well that the reconstruction of Asterleeds would take years.
This meant they would no longer have the time or opportunity to work with Legacies, and their early research would be lost to time.

60080015.Content:
As the Asterleeds Independence War stretched beyond its first grueling year, the once-unshakable front of Byrnhald began to fracture. Whispers of internal discord rippled through their ranks, and the effects were soon felt on the battlefield-
supply lines faltered for reasons that remained unclear.
Consequently, the fighting force was severely weakened.
In contrast, Asterleeds-
with the support of skilled artisans-upgraded its military equipment, achieving outstanding results in holding back the enemy.
Asterians' fervent longing for freedom has not been dimmed by sacrifice.
Inspired by Olvera and Tina, numerous heroes emerged among the Asterleeds Defense Corps, whose courage continued to grow.

In the first year of the Asterleeds Independence War, Byrnhald failed to defeat Asterleeds.
...
As the war entered its second year,
Byrnhald's cross-regional operations drained substantial resources, and even the
once-invincible Byrnhald Knights began to show signs of fatigue.

Despite these challenges, Byrnhald refused to withdraw its troops, leading the war into a prolonged battle of attrition.
With the advantage of fighting on home turf, Asterleeds gradually gained the upper hand in the struggle.

Just as the situation was becoming clearer, an unexpected piece of news arrived...

60080016.Content:
—Chronicles of the Independence War, Volume IV—
Towards the end of the Independence War, the Creed suddenly issued a warning to both warring parties.
The Seal upon Hruga in the central sea was damaged, causing a severe ​Void Engram disaster in the surrounding area.
Creatures engulfed by the Void Engram were turned into mindless monsters...
If the seal was not repaired in time, the ​Void Engram disaster would endanger the entire human race, and even the whole Continent of Magna.

Unexpectedly, this sudden event inadvertently fostered unprecedented unity among the human forces.
At the Creed's command, not just Asterleeds and Byrnhald, but adventurers active in various regions,
and even nomads, threw themselves into the battle against the Void Engram disaster.

For a time, the human forces were active on an unprecedented scale, like stars shining in the dark night.
The activity of the humans even drew the attention of the Divine. The Bapharian Divines also sent envoys to help humanity through the crisis.

After many hardships, the various factions finally achieved their goal.
The plot of Hruga's followers was crushed, and Hruga's seal was repaired.

After the crisis was resolved, Byrnhald and Asterleeds, with the Creed mediating, finally...
They signed an armistice agreement, the Peace Treaty.

Thus, the Asterians welcomed an age of freedom.

60080201.Content:
(This is a neatly written letter radiating sunlight.)
Dear Federico,
I am so happy to see you pursuing your dream (of course, I'm also a little sad that my lovely little son has left my side), but I know you are so smart and will surely achieve great things. This village of ours is too small to fulfill your ambitions.
The day you came back covered in wounds after bravely fighting to protect an old man who was being robbed,
you don't know how sad I was, how many tears I shed, my dear Federico...
Many neighbors and young people on the street mocked your weakness, but I know, only your mother knows, that it is all because of your kind virtues.
Believe firmly that your virtues are more powerful than your fists, Federico. Do not forget this. I hope you are doing well in Asterleeds!
P.S.: Is it cold? Are you eating well? Have you made any new friends? Is your living allowance still enough?
If you run into any trouble, remember to write back!

60080202.Content:
(This letter is written in slightly messy handwriting, clearly reflecting the writer's lively personality.) My dear brother! I'm so happy you've decided to chase your dream-and you really did it!
An adventurer! And in Asterleeds, no less!
What an incredible place it is. Everything and everyone there seems to be made of dreams and sunshine. The sea sparkles, the economy thrives, and the commercial capital is not only a center of trade, but also a city of art, of freedom, and of miracles. It holds a long history filled with legends, and yet it keeps evolving and moving forward.
In my imagination, it's as sweet and beautiful as a glass candy wrapper.
As for you-I'm not worried one bit, dear Federico. You're so clever, and you always understand how others feel. You just need a little experience, and you'll grow up faster than anyone else.
I truly believe you'll become a great adventurer! (But hey-if you ever run into anything upsetting, just write to me! I won't tell Mom, promise, heh)
Also! If you ever meet the legendary Airona, please, please get her autograph! And if you can, could you ask her whether the details about the Sealing War in her latest book, The Legend of the Eternal Earth, are actually true?
It's almost dawn here, so I'll stop writing now.
Your sister, who's eagerly waiting for your reply and really hates making breakfast,
-Anna

60080203.ChatName: Draft of a Reply to Mom
60080203.Content:
(This is a draft of a letter from a young adventurer to his family. Below is a collection of discarded drafts.)
To my dearest mother,
I've been in Asterleeds for over a month now, and just recently, I passed the entrance exam for the Pioneer Bureau-I'm officially an adventurer! I'm so happy. All the effort I put in has finally paid off.
(This sentence is crossed out.) At first, the exam was quite challenging for me, until I realized that brute strength wasn't everything for beating the monsters. Mastering the use of Legacy weapons turned out to be just as important-and that became the key to victory.
As a novice adventurer, the Pioneer Bureau introduced me to a senior mentor. It wasn't mandatory-more like a friendly guide to chat with and share life experiences. Luckily, we get along really well. He's cheerful, warm, and incredibly familiar with Asterleeds. He's shown me so much about the city, and it feels like we're more friends than mentor and apprentice. It's been great.
Speaking of Asterleeds-the sunshine here is wonderful, the city is lively, and there are so many more people than back home. The streets are always bustling with travelers and locals from all walks of life. (This sentence is crossed out.) I've been eating really well lately-there's so much going on that my appetite has grown. You probably wouldn't recognize me if you saw me now. I've gotten a lot stronger!
But I must confess-no delicacy here rivals your cooking, Mother. I already crave that taste of your tomato & braised lamb stew (the next few words blur into ink-smudged stains... This draft ends here.)

60080204.ChatName: Draft of a Reply to Anna
60080204.Content:
(This is a draft of a letter from a young adventurer to his family, with many crossed-out sections and scribbled notes.)
To Anna,
(This entire paragraph is crossed out.) I have to be honest. I do like Asterleeds, but that doesn't stop me from sometimes feeling like I don't belong here. In this colorful, bright, steaming, shining city, there is everything-silks, saddles, belts, dashing hats, beautiful feathers, satin, weapons, Legacy items, jewelry-everything the world has to offer, gathered here and within reach. I enjoy admiring it all, yet still... sometimes, I feel out of place. This city feels like a stationary ship, and many who come here chasing their dreams don't realize that their tickets have an expiration date. I'm chasing mine too, but I often worry-what if all my efforts end up meaningless?
(There is a scribbled note at the top of the next paragraph: "Use this paragraph!")
Anna, listen-I'm doing well, and I'm definitely not going to give you a reason to laugh at me! Don't worry, if anything goes wrong, I'll figure it out. Don't forget, I used to help you out at school when we were kids-though, yeah, I'll admit I also kept you up way too late chatting.
I've actually seen Airona a few times... but I haven't had the courage to talk to her yet. She's Airona, after all-and I'm still just a beginner out here. (The letter pauses here, unfinished.)

Welcome to your stay at The Double-Faced Coin! Please read and follow the guidelines below-unless you'd like to see your bill grow longer than your adventure log.

Guests are encouraged to contribute their own books to enrich the collection-or head downstairs, order a Drink Mixing, and join a good conversation on books. Let stories and knowledge flow freely.

60080611.Content:
Author: Jon

In the past, conditions were extremely harsh, and the level of Legacy excavation was nowhere near what it is today.
Legacies beneficial to housing, furniture, or domestic life were exceedingly rare.
According to some older residents, Asterleeds at that time could hardly even be called a city-more like a small town in scale.
With a rapidly growing population, residents were soon faced with issues like housing shortages, lack of daily necessities, and inadequate public infrastructure.
The then-governing body, which would later evolve into the Council, issued a call for housing artisans. But few responded.

Under such circumstances, a number of Legacy experts stepped forward. They willingly put aside their valuable research work,
and threw themselves into grueling tasks like house design, infrastructure repair, and furniture crafting.

One must understand-working with Legacies is the very reason many became artisans. It was their dream.
These Legacy experts knew full well that Asterleeds restoration would take many years.
Which meant... they would no longer have the chance to frequently interact with Legacies. All their early research would be reduced to nothing.
Even so, this group of artisans used their knowledge of Legacy
and combined it with traditional construction techniques-they created something unprecedented.
...
The leading artisan among them was named "Webber."
At a time when Legacy utilization was still low, he insisted on designing a city-wide energy network system.

This idea was both bold and visionary. Thanks to his early planning during the reconstruction phase,
Asterleeds today enjoys the widespread use of Legacy-based energy systems. His contributions laid the foundation.
In today's Asterleeds, kitchen appliances in wealthy households, ventilation systems in restaurants...
or even lighting, signage systems, etc.-all operate thanks to the energy network designed by Webber.

To commemorate the dedication of these artisans, and Webber's foresight,
Asterleeds energy system was officially renamed "Webber."
These admirable artisans.

60080612.Content:
-Technology Advances with Every Discovery-
Author: Mason Stonecutter
-A Promising Future
Recently, some argue that technological development is overly dependent on Legacies.
This is a narrow-minded view.
Artisans shouldn't only focus on the technology in their hands. They need to understand the real value of Legacy research.
...
The Creed restricts access to high-risk Legacies.
But it does not hinder the Legacy research.
On the contrary, there has been an undeniable surge in innovations emerging from Legacy studies.

Some might say that the artisans' brilliant achievements are just a byproduct of adventurers discovering Legacies.
But I believe the value of Legacy research isn't limited to the act of study itself.

As the saying goes, "A rising tide lifts all boats." The immense power of Legacies does not merely pull artisans along.
It drives us forward.

If those people set aside their bias and look at the Artisan Guild as a whole, they would see:
Thanks to the impressive progress in Legacy modifications,
innovations have emerged across other fields as well, and the research within the Guild has been elevated overall.
...

With the continued efforts of adventurers, perhaps more Legacies will be discovered, or perhaps not.
Either way, Legacy research has opened a small window,
through which we can see a future filled with infinite possibilities.

A future that belongs to us, to humanity itself.
And that future is being forged by the hands of artisans.

60080614.Content:
Among the many apartment buildings lining Asterleeds main street, there is one that stands out. Unlike the nearby residential blocks, this hive-like structure has been repurposed into a workspace for scholars. Researchers from all walks of life and from across the Continent of Magna live and work here—learning, exchanging ideas with students, and cultivating a rich, dynamic academic atmosphere.
In a city where prices and rent continue to soar, the thirst for knowledge and energy for exploration inside this building has never waned. Perhaps this is the very spirit that fuels Asterleeds inquisitiveness. The hallways are lined with posters of various disciplines, seminars, research paper titles, and intricate diagrams. Debates often echo through the corridors-clashing tones and viewpoints from different academic schools fill the air.
Naturally, you'll see young students scattered across the city-troubled by academic dilemmas or confused about their future-they, too, have become part of Asterleeds vibrant and tangled cultural landscape.

60080615.Content:
Many of Asterleeds traditional street stalls-reflecting the cultural customs of this port-city of commerce-offer you salty smoked meats, flavorful seafood sauces, body-strengthening vegetables, rich fats, and fiery hotclouds of spice... but provide no seating. There's a kind of fleeting atmosphere here. People come to drink heartily, not to taste delicately.
Like the rolling sea, the city breathes in motion-it never lingers still. That is the air of Asterleeds. But then, as a visitor, how do you know which stall has the best flavor? There's one very simple trick: trust the kids on the street. The orphanages in Asterleeds take in children who lost their families to wilderness monsters or the Asterleeds Independence War. And in their eyes, you'll find the truest map of alleyways and taste.

60080616.Content:
Adventurers also tend to pick up the cooking style passed down from the harbor: Ingredients are few, prep is simple. Put plainly, it's all because the ingredients themselves are exceptional.
For grilled meat, the best wood is fine oak or olive wood. Seasoning? Just salt. Spices are great, yes, but for those in a rush to pursue dreams or trade opportunities, spice use already belongs to another, more leisurely kind of cooking.

60080617.ChatName: The Fun of Wild Mountain Mushrooms
60080617.Content: Ugly in appearance and notoriously difficult to cultivate, yet possessing a taste beyond words-this is the wild mountain mushroom. It's common knowledge around Asterleeds: to locate the best, freshest wild mushrooms, you need either a specially trained, sharp-nosed dog, or a specially trained, sharp-eyed adventurer. Just a touch of wild flavor from nature can completely transform a dish steeped in the city's scent. So, when harvest season comes-and if your budget allows-head over to the Pioneer Bureau and put in a commission. Try your luck and get some top-grade wild mushrooms.

60080618.Content: Before you decide to throw all your ingredients into the pot-stop and think for a moment! You know what happens when you swing a weapon at wood. You know a rock thrown from a height makes a splash. You know that when people are hurt, they bleed. So why don't you stop to think? Cooking isn't some miraculous act done without thought. It's an art built on solid logic. First-what's your main ingredient? What complementary ingredients will you use? What cooking method suits them best? Only when you've thought through all this-organized your ideas and prepped your tools-can things go smoothly.

60080624.Content:
Newsflash: Fireworks Festival Restarts! Tina Returns Safely
By: A Spectacled Shrimp

3 days ago, there was an accident at the Fireworks Festival opening. During Tina's medal ceremony, a strange black mist suddenly appeared.
According to eyewitnesses, it resembled the terrifying Void Engram from years past.
Fortunately, the Asterleeds Defense Corps and the Pioneer Bureau quickly contained the scene and no one was injured.
What's strange is that Tina disappeared during the chaos. Though she has now returned safely, why did she disappear? Was the strange mist truly Void Engram? The mysteries surrounding the incident remain deeply intriguing.
The Council Hall has now issued a statement declaring the situation under control, and both the Seabreeze Festival and the Fireworks Festival will proceed as planned.
"We can't let this incident ruin everyone's good mood," said Council Chair Lamond. But is there a deeper meaning behind his words?
Our reporters will continue to follow this story.

60090106.Content:
Since leaving Asterleeds, nothing has gone right for me. Lost my tent, struggled forever to make a fire, and then the bottom of my only pot burned out. Is this punishment for abandoning my mission and duty?
But I don't regret my choice. I will see every corner of The Continent of Magna. This has been my childhood dream, and I must fulfill it for myself.
Behold, how magnificent and captivating this Forsaken Trail is! With a sight like this before me, what do a few hardships matter?

60090201.Content: Those who follow should know: Brave souls once lived here. When the wicked winged dragon descended upon the Bahamar Highlands, they took up arms and fought the beast until the final breath, turning to ash alongside Augurus Village.

60090202.Content:
Congratulate me! Through countless trials, I finally reached the westernmost edge of the Bahamar Highlands purely on my own, without begging a single coin from my family. The surging sea of clouds beneath the cliff is a magnificent sight. And at sunset, those red clouds, like spilled fire, truly capture the heart.
Congratulate me. Here and now, I've found the meaning of my life.

60090203.Content:
Great. The rain soaked everything I own. But I still have to eat. Tore off a bit of water-soaked bread. Ugh!
My compass is acting up, so I trusted my sense of direction and headed north... at least I think it was north.
I never imagined the end of this aimless path would lead to the source of the Fallen River! All my exhaustion and grumbling mean nothing beside this beauty. My respect to the river that shines like a silver ribbon!

60090417.Content:
We cannot cross the divide between the Bapharian Divine and humankind. Even if we could, the moment we crossed it, the Bapharian Divine's sanctity would vanish, something that could never happen.
But because we know only a fraction of the Divine's greatness, not the whole of it, some people stray into arrogance.
They pick up a few precious fragments and imagine they've grasped the whole of the Divine.

60090419.Content: By the grace of the Bapharian Divines, could you give me a hint? In the coming year, should I change my profession, or continue with my current, endless trade?

60090421.Content: By the grace of the Bapharian Divines, where do we go after this life ends? Is it really the Divine Garden the Priests speak of? By the grace of the Bapharian Divines, will you meet my daughter?

60090422.Content:
Mom, I'm writing to you again, hoping you can send me some money... Please consider this a loan.
I'm hungry every day. I can't fill my stomach, and I can't find work here. My savings are almost gone.
Mom, please, I desperately need the money.
With love, Myrtle.



I've found you more than one job, yet you offer a hundred excuses. I choose not to argue. I also pinned my hopes on you continuing your education, but you insist the current subjects do not interest you. I let you stay home doing nothing because you said once you made a pilgrimage to the Pillar of Divinity, you'd finally know which path to take. One month, two months... I sent you money repeatedly, yet here you are.
I am old now, too old to care when you finally figure out your future, and too old to continue funding your life. From now on, you must walk your own path.

60090502.Content:
Introduction

This book is divided into three parts. Part I shares four case studies of adventurers who received Liquid Memory infusions, along with data showing their changes before and after.
Part II explains the current storage and application methods of Liquid Memory, and includes excerpts from research exploring its possible ties to the Bapharian Divine.
Part III lists potential research directions aimed at uncovering the mechanisms behind Liquid Memory's components. Once you understand the concept of Liquid Memory and the current findings, exploring the directions derived from it becomes much easier.

60090504.Content:
To most people, stone means hardness and stubborn will. Call someone cold-hearted and you say they have a heart of stone. But Holmes sees it differently. Three years ago, the brilliant geologist arrived at the Bahamar Highlands, throwing himself into fieldwork with boundless passion. Through Holmes's highly romantic lens, those giant stones piercing the sky above the highland seem to radiate endless vitality. They whisper in the wind, recounting the stories of the highland across tens of thousands of years. "You must listen carefully when stones speak," Holmes often insists. And within this book, he truly acts as the bridge between humanity and the rock, allowing us to understand the stone's very soul, and the human civilization that, like a tide, has washed over them, leaving its lasting mark.

(A line of messy handwriting is visible at the bottom of the title page.)

Oh, so it's about listening to the stones speak. I thought it was about listening to the stones speak!

60090505.ChatName: A Life's Worth of Advice for Traveling Merchants
60090505.Content:
Traveling merchant, heed these lessons. They'll serve you all your life!

1. Before you set out as a traveling merchant, raise a plant. Sweet Berry, Hero's Herb, Mustard—any of those will do. But never Alpine Cotton or Illusory Bloom. The former's cotton fibers scatter too easily, which is a bad omen for profit. The latter is not even a true plant, and it endangers life.
2. Tend to your plant well, and don't let anyone lay a hand on it.
3. If a competitor acts rudely first, you may seize the opportunity to pour a kettle of boiling water onto the roots of their plant.
4. Make sure your Battle Pass is ready.
5. Always check the weather before setting out to trade. Bring an umbrella, no matter what.
6. Never pair a red checkered scarf with a green coat.
7. When passing the Bahamar Highlands, you can stay a night in Lallipar; but don't try the local dishes, and don't accept fruit the villagers hand you.
8. Don't travel through the Montegnor Valley after dark.

...

(Dozens more entries are omitted here, covering everything from meals and lodging to social etiquette.)

102. Loss brings gain. If you lose something, someone else gains something. Money and goods can be earned again. A calmer heart is the best gain of all.

60090612.Content:
Dear Aylen,
Forgive me for calling you this one last time. Ever since you were drafted and left Byrnhald, my life has held a void nothing can fill. I still remember the Solemn Outskirts under the setting sun, where we made our promises. And how you burned your tongue on my mother's apple pie, speechless from the heat. Those were our most carefree days. I wish time had stopped for us.
Aylen... my Aylen... (the ink has bled beyond recognition) my mother is gravely ill. Her only wish is to see me married. I can't deny her that, and I know... you'd understand why I made this choice...
I dreamed of marrying you once. Many times. We even talked about the details. You said our ceremony would be held in Byrnhald's most beautiful season, blessed by the Bapharian Divine. I'll speak with him, and avoid that season. If not for you, so many things would lose their meaning.
I'm sorry, Aylen.
(The ink has blurred)
A thousand "I love yous," and a thousand "Please forgive me."

Shaene, the Crying Betrayer

60090702.Content:
(A handwritten poetry collection. Repeated examination reveals no signature.)

Traveler, traveler, where do you roam?
You cross the highland and the river. I offer no comfort for your road.
The scarlet lies forever buried. The living mourn in futile woe.
Traveler, traveler, where do you go?
The path coils without end, and the night chills like frost.
With dust and pickax in hand, all I can do is pray for you.
I pray for you.

60090808.Content:
It's true what they say: as you age, the memories of childhood resurface. I recall how much I detested attending funerals. Once, I hid just before we left the house, and I paid for that with a severe thrashing from my parents. Back then, just thinking that people could disappear from the world one day used to make me shake all over. Yet no one escapes the day of their own farewell.
My time is almost up now. Oddly, realizing this truth brings no terror, only a deep sense of sorrow and regret. I failed my parents. I never managed to become the source of pride they deserved. I'm sorry to my dear Patricia—for leaving her to raise seven children alone. When those Byrnhald bastards conscripted us, our youngest wasn't even seven months old. I can never repay what I owe Patricia in this life...
Among my belongings is a pack of dried Hyphae shreds. Give it to the crew to roll into cigarettes.
A set of work clothes should go to anyone who needs it, whether to wear or to cut into patches.
There are also eighty-seven Luno—my stash hidden in my shoe sole before I left. I hope a trustworthy person will keep it, and if possible, take it to Asterleeds and give it to Patricia.
My dear Patricia...

(The handwriting grows messier toward the end, turning into illegible scribbles. It finishes with a sudden, harsh line that even tears through the paper.)

60091101.Content:
Dear Mom and Dad,
I'm writing this letter at the Sislesa Mines because (large portions crossed out) I miss you both so much.
How have you been? It's been bitterly cold here lately. I guess Asterleeds has entered a new winter too... Dress warm, especially you, Dad—don't spend day and night fishing at the harbor in that icy wind. Recently I've been (large portions crossed out) doing fine overall. I just don't know when I'll be able to leave this place. I really wish I could curl up by the hearth with you again, like before, and compete over who can drink more "Nakonako"... (large portions crossed out) If only this letter could be sent...
All the best to you, Mom and Dad.
Your son, Orrin

8000053.Content: Pioneers, make sure you're all set before heading out

8000054.Content: We've discovered traces of large creatures. The situation is far more serious than we anticipated. To put it simply... Pioneers

8000055.Content: This is the first rift. The space within can be stabilized using the device

8000056.Content: There are still significant interference signals in the other two zones. Our investigators are working diligently to analyze them

8000057.Content: Now, <style="emph-gn">leader</style> can touch the rift to reach the nest of large creature. Good luck!

8000058.Content: Although I didn't witness the battle firsthand, the wave signals emitted from the rift indicate it must have been intense and extraordinary

8000059.Content: The second rift shows signs of Void Corruption-please exercise caution

8000060.Content: The second rift still requires considerable time to stabilize. Pioneers, please return later

8000061.Content: I didn't expect the giant dragon to succumb to Void and become imprisoned...

8000062.Content: This is highly valuable research data-thank you for your efforts!

8000063.Content: The final rift is experiencing violent space-time fluctuations. Pioneers, you must be fully prepared before entering

8000064.Content: The last space remains extremely unstable and requires more time... Pioneers, please return later

8000065.Content: That was truly an unparalleled battle. Thank you all for your contributions in defending Asterleeds!

8000102.Content: Primary target is using DMG Reduction! Tanks: Be ready to taunt!

8000103.Content: Place crystals around the <style="emph-gn">center and edges</style> of the arena!

8000104.Content: Get ready to <style="emph-gn">interact with crystals</style> to resist Spacetime Blitz!

8000105.Content: Get ready to <style="emph-gn">interact with rifts</style> to avoid Purifying Light!

8000106.Content: Move away from the center and to the sides!
