8000205.Content: Heavy snow falls... Stay close to Allies!

8000206.Content: Blizzard rages... Group up with more players!

8000207.Content: Devastating strike incoming! Enter the red circle to share incoming DMG!

8000208.Content: Avalanche targeting! Keep a distance from Allies!

8000209.Content: Zero-degree Snowfield targeting! Find Allies to share incoming DMG!

8000210.Content: Frost Shock targeting! Watch the boss's facing direction!

8000211.Content: Ice Lance targeting! Stay close to the boss!

8000212.Content: The Ice Dragon has retreated to its lair! Pursue!

8000213.Content: Frost Spiral! Enter the burning zone to avoid being frozen!

8000219.Content: Not enough players nearby, about to freeze!

8000220.Content: Fire Dragon is going berserk! Quickly bring it down!

8000230.Content: This is a complete and utter disaster... Bapharia, have you abandoned us?

8000231.Content: No... it can't end like this... Adventurers... go. Go to the depths beyond the doors. Destroy the flowers and shatter the illusion...

8000232.Content: We can't let the plague spread to the grasslands and poison the air.

8000233.Content: Behind the door lies the doom you must face. Cross it and judge them!

8000234.Content: It's not a flower? It's... parasitized?

8000235.Content: It doesn't matter. You're still alive. Is it luck, or strength?

8000236.Content: I admit I'm pessimistic... No one could remain spirited after what I've been through, but...

8000237.Content: Will the answer lie behind the last door? Tell me, adventurers. Will we find the answer inside?

8000238.Content: The parasitized new king is dead. The old king triumphs still! I knew we wouldn't lose. There's still a chance!

8000239.Content: As long as I remain awake... I'll see the day the "Illusory Plague" ends...

8000240.Content: I believe in you. Go, adventurers! The first door has closed. We must open the second and face its trial!

8000241.Content: Kaff, kaff... even divine weapons can end up like this? My Bapharia, what remains of the legacy you left us?

8000242.Content: Adventurers, thank you. The whole highlands will remember you all and pass down your stories for generations.

8000243.Content: May this plague born from illusion end here. No matter its cause, no one can bear another catastrophe...

8000244.Content: A new door... The threat of the boulder has never left. I wonder what form it'll take when it returns.

8000245.Content: I hear its voice. It's getting close, like the mountains themselves are roaring... We must not back down...

8000246.Content: Don't rush, adventurers. I still have time... I can hold on...

8000247.Content: The last door... I can feel its pulse... This is the signal of its awakening. I can hear it breathing...

8000248.Content: We must listen and wait... No, at least not now. Opening it too soon will bring irreversible consequences...

8000249.Content: <style="emph-gn">Captain</style> can touch the rift to lead the team to the boss's lair.

8000401.Content: The device is locked and cannot be moved!

8000402.Content: You're targeted! Cannot put down the device during this period

8000403.Content: This is bad! The Illusory Bloom's power has turned the Stonehusk berserk. We gotta figure something out.

8000404.Content: Pioneers, the ruins' defense device is in a dormant state. Though we haven't fully researched its structure...

8000405.Content: We have to take the risk. <style="emph-gn">Break the shield on the defense device</style>. We must activate this unknown power!

8000406.Content: If the device is hit by the Boss's <style="emph-gn">powerful attack</style>, it will trigger the defense mechanism and deal massive DMG to players. <style="emph-gn">Protect the device</style>!

8000407.Content: Being too close to other devices <style="emph-gn">affects</style> its effects. Spread out!

8000408.Content: Gathering near the device generates an <style="emph-gn">Acceleration Field</style> that resists the Boss's storm repulsion!

8000409.Content: The Stonehusk has fled deeper into the ruins. Take the <style="emph-gn">defense device</style> and continue the chase!

8000410.Content: Huh... So many Illusory Blooms. It seems the mutation has fully taken root here. Pioneers, be careful!

8000411.Content: When the Boss gets near an Illusory Bloom, it will destroy it and cause a <style="emph-gn">large-area attack</style>! Clear the Illusory Blooms along the path

8000412.Content: A sandstorm is forming behind us. Players within the area will take <style="emph-gn">Instant Kill</style> DMG.

8000413.Content: Break the Boss's <style="emph-gn">shield</style> before its Destruction Skill is unleashed!

8000414.Content: Take the <style="emph-gn">defense device</style> and continue pursuing the Boss!

8000415.Content: The Stonehusk's attacks prevent dodging. Approach the device to generate an <style="emph-gn">Acceleration Field</style>, and avoid the falling rocks in the area!

8000416.Content: Move to the device to <style="emph-gn">take the damage</style>!

8000417.Content: Targeted by <style="emph-gn">Crag Ring</style>! Move to a suitable location to place it!

8000418.Content: Withered Illusory Bloom is now vulnerable!

8000500.Content: Signal link complete. Cleanup protocol terminated!

8000505.Content: Guide the skill to eliminate the Scarlet Swordshades on the field! Prepare to heal!

8000508.Content: Use the sweep to eliminate the Scarlet Swordshades! Prepare to heal!

8000509.Content: Erosion Bloom Afterimage is now vulnerable! Attack now!

8000510.Content: Use the wind tunnels on both sides to reach the distant control consoles.

8000511.Content: Decode the signal and interrupt Erosion Bloom Afterimage's charging sequence!

8000512.Content: The rift to the Final Battleground has opened!

8000513.Content: Operate the device to enter the password. Use the prompt about correct digits to try other number combinations!

8000514.Content: At least 4 players required to share the damage!

8000515.Content: At least 5 players required to share the damage!

8000601.Content: Use the laser to destroy the energy cores in the arena!

8000602.Content: Room 1 energy is nearing full charge!

8000603.Content: Room 2 energy is nearing full charge!

8000604.Content: Room 3 energy is nearing full charge!

8000605.Content: Room 4 energy is nearing full charge!

8000610.Content: Damage detected. Switching to flight mode.

8000650.Content: Go, Adventurer! I'll keep a close eye on its changes!

8000651.Content: Be careful, Adventurer! Its systems are becoming increasingly unstable!

8000652.Content: Don't let your guard down, Adventurer! It's already nothing like what it was at the start!

8000653.Content: You must be careful, Adventurer! That thing is completely out of control. I have no idea what it will turn into next!

8000654.Content: Well done... It's finally stopped! We've got enough data to analyze now!

8000655.Content: Phew... Looking at it now, I can't help but feel this isn't truly over yet...

8000656.Content: It stopped again... But that eerie feeling is even more pronounced than before...

8000657.Content: Is it... is it finally over...? I still don't feel at ease. I'm afraid this thing has long been beyond anything logic can explain...

8000658.Content: The consciousness latched on to the wreckage has finally completed its cycle. Return to zero, now!

8000701.Content: Watch out—the railgun will damage the platforms! Come together and guide the railgun's strikes in staggered waves!

8000702.Content: <style="emph-gn">Gather with allies</style> to share the damage!

8000703.Content: Prioritize eliminating the Mech Sentinels! Watch out—when a Mech Sentinel's energy is full, it will destroy the platform beneath it!

8000704.Content: The energy cubes summoned by the boss will then drop onto their corresponding platforms!

8000705.Content: Clear out the Mech Sentinels to make the boss resume fighting!

9200064.Content: Reflects AoE DMG equal to 400% of your <style="emph-gn">Armor</style> when hit

9200082.Content:
Each Expertise cast increases its DMG and Healing by 0.5%.
Stacks up to 200 times. When fully stacked, grants 50% Expertise DMG and Healing boost

9200083.Content:
Each Special Attack increases its DMG and Healing by 0.5%.
Stacks up to 200 times. When fully stacked, grants 50% Special Attack DMG and healing boost

9200095.Content:
After each battle, Mastery +3%
Deals DMG equal to 100% of your MATK per second to nearby enemies, and adds extra DMG equal to 100% of your Healing over the past second

9200096.Content:
After each battle, Versatility +3%
On hit, deals additional AoE DMG equal to 1500% of Armor to targets within 5m (triggers at most once per second)

9200097.Content:
After each battle, Haste +3%
Attacks have a chance to trigger Double DMG, based on your total Haste percentage

9200098.Content:
Lucky Strikes may trigger Poisoned Sting, Frenzied Shot, Thunder Suppress, Blazing Axe, or Meteor Shower
After each battle, Luck Rate +3%. Luck Damage bonus scales with current Luck Rate

9200099.Content:
After each battle, Crit Rate +3%
Any Crit Rate above 50% is converted into twice as much Crit DMG.

Its shield is highly unusual... ordinary weapons cannot break it.

This Laser Turret might be able to pierce it.
But it seems to be out of energy. If you have a "Charging Module" on you, we might still have a chance to win.

Now's our chance—finish it off!
